+"""Select complete non-evaluation components for the recurrent interaction screen."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from wnn.splits import load_campaign_split  # noqa: E402
+from wnn.training.membership import load_component_fit_subset  # noqa: E402
+
+SPLIT_PATH = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+OUTPUT_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("fit_subset_manifest_r1.json")
+EXPERIMENT_ID = "E-KALMAN-GROUP-RECURRENT-INTERACTION-20261018-R1"
+SEED = 20261018
+COMPONENT_LIMIT = 32
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    split = load_campaign_split(SPLIT_PATH, ROOT)
+    by_component: dict[int, dict[str, list[int]]] = defaultdict(lambda: {"train": [], "valid": []})
+    group_components: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
+    for source, group, component in split.components:
+        by_component[int(component)][source].append(int(group))
+        group_components[source, int(group)] = int(component)
+
+    evaluation_components = {group_components["valid", group] for group in split.evaluation_groups}
+    available = sorted(
+        component
+        for component, groups in by_component.items()
+        if component not in evaluation_components and groups["train"] and groups["valid"]
+    )
+    if len(available) < COMPONENT_LIMIT:
+        raise RuntimeError("not enough source-complete non-evaluation components")
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
+    selected_components = sorted(
+        int(value) for value in rng.choice(available, size=COMPONENT_LIMIT, replace=False)
+    )
+    selected_groups = {
+        source: sorted(
+            group for component in selected_components for group in by_component[component][source]
+        )
+        for source in ("train", "valid")
+    }
+    members = sorted(
+        (source, group) for source, groups in selected_groups.items() for group in groups
+    )
+    evaluation_groups = sorted(int(group) for group in split.evaluation_groups)
+    manifest = {
+        "version": 1,
+        "experiment_id": EXPERIMENT_ID,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "selection_seed": SEED,
+        "selection_policy": "uniform_without_replacement_from_fit_components_present_in_train_and_valid_v1",
+        "requested_component_count": COMPONENT_LIMIT,
+        "selected_components": selected_components,
+        "selected_component_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            np.asarray(selected_components, dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "selected_groups": selected_groups,
+        "selected_members_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            json.dumps(members, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("ascii")
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "evaluation_groups": evaluation_groups,
+        "evaluation_group_count": len(evaluation_groups),
+        "evaluation_membership_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            np.asarray(evaluation_groups, dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+    }
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    validated = load_component_fit_subset(OUTPUT_PATH, split, expected_experiment_id=EXPERIMENT_ID)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "manifest": str(OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),
+                "manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(OUTPUT_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                "selected_component_count": len(validated["manifest"]["selected_components"]),
+                "selected_group_counts": {
+                    source: len(groups) for source, groups in selected_groups.items()
+                },
+                "evaluation_groups": len(evaluation_groups),
+                "split_manifest_sha256": split.sha256,
+            },
+            indent=2,
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Freeze and validate seed-4 feature-only predictions before official grading."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SPLIT_PATH = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+RUNS = (
+    "kalman_groupfast_active_f0_s4_r1",
+    "kalman_groupfast_zero_f0_s4_r1",
+)
+EXPECTED_SHAPE = (468, 20_000, 2)
+CHUNK_GROUPS = 32
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Return a file's SHA-256 without loading it all into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_prediction(name: str, groups: list[int], split_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate one feature-only prediction and its evaluation membership sidecar."""
+    path = ROOT / "cache" / f"pred_{name}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar_path = path.with_suffix(".json")
+    sidecar = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    expected_membership = hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(groups, dtype="<i8").tobytes()).hexdigest()
+    if (
+        sidecar.get("campaign_export_scope") != "evaluation"
+        or sidecar.get("feature_only") is not True
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: export is not feature-only evaluation inference")
+    if sidecar.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: split hash differs from the frozen F0 manifest")
+    if sidecar.get("row_groups") != groups:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: row-group order differs from the frozen evaluation list")
+    if sidecar.get("evaluation_membership_sha256") != expected_membership:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: evaluation membership hash differs")
+    if sidecar.get("prediction_sha256") != sha256_file(path):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction sidecar hash differs from the file")
+
+    prediction = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+    if prediction.shape != EXPECTED_SHAPE or prediction.dtype != np.float32:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: expected float32 prediction shape {EXPECTED_SHAPE}")
+    for start in range(0, len(groups), CHUNK_GROUPS):
+        if not np.isfinite(prediction[start : start + CHUNK_GROUPS]).all():
+            raise FloatingPointError(f"{name}: non-finite prediction values")
+
+    checkpoint_path = ROOT / "artifacts/runs" / name / "model_ep0.pt"
+    checkpoint_sha256 = sha256_file(checkpoint_path)
+    if sidecar.get("checkpoint_sha256") != checkpoint_sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction sidecar checkpoint hash differs")
+    return {
+        "run": name,
+        "prediction_path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
+        "prediction_sha256": sha256_file(path),
+        "sidecar_sha256": sha256_file(sidecar_path),
+        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha256,
+        "shape": list(prediction.shape),
+        "dtype": str(prediction.dtype),
+        "finite": True,
+        "feature_only_evaluation_export": True,
+        "evaluation_membership_sha256": expected_membership,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Write a label-blind receipt binding both predictions to one F0 panel."""
+    split_bytes = SPLIT_PATH.read_bytes()
+    split = json.loads(split_bytes)
+    groups = [int(group) for group in split["evaluation"]["valid"]]
+    if len(groups) != EXPECTED_SHAPE[0]:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected {EXPECTED_SHAPE[0]} evaluation groups, found {len(groups)}")
+
+    outputs = [
+        validate_prediction(name, groups, hashlib.sha256(split_bytes).hexdigest()) for name in RUNS
+    ]
+    if outputs[0]["evaluation_membership_sha256"] != outputs[1]["evaluation_membership_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("active and control predictions do not share evaluation membership")
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "wnn.kalman_group_recurrent_seed4_prediction_freeze.v1",
+        "experiment_id": "E-KALMAN-GROUP-RECURRENT-SEED4-20261018-R1",
+        "split_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(split_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "evaluation_group_count": len(groups),
+        "evaluation_membership_sha256": outputs[0]["evaluation_membership_sha256"],
+        "predictions": outputs,
+        "targets_read": False,
+        "masks_read": False,
+        "status": "frozen_feature_only_predictions_ready_for_official_grade",
+        "source_sha256": {
+            "script": sha256_file(Path(__file__)),
+            "split": sha256_file(SPLIT_PATH),
+        },
+    }
+    output_path = PACKET / "prediction_freeze_seed4_r1.json"
+    if output_path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to overwrite {output_path}")
+    output_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    logging.info("Wrote label-blind prediction freeze receipt to %s", output_path)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s")
+    main()

+"""Grade a frozen recurrent-feature pair on the fixed F0 evaluation panel."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
+
+from grade_prediction_bank import SCORED_FROM_ROW, Lazy, aligned, score, sha256  # noqa: E402
+
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap, paired_component_moments  # noqa: E402
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SPLIT_PATH = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+TARGETS_PATH = ROOT / "cache/valid_targets.npz"
+ACTIVE = "kalman_groupfast_active_f0_s3_r1"
+CONTROL = "kalman_groupfast_zero_f0_s3_r1"
+BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS = 2_000
+BOOTSTRAP_SEED = 20261018
+TIME_BINS = ((99, 500), (500, 2_000), (2_000, 10_000), (10_000, 20_000))
+
+
+def _load_prediction(
+    name: str, groups: list[int], split_sha256: str
+) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load a row-aligned prediction only after validating its feature-only sidecar."""
+    path = ROOT / "cache" / f"pred_{name}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar_path = path.with_suffix(".json")
+    sidecar = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if sidecar.get("campaign_export_scope") != "evaluation" or not sidecar.get("feature_only"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction export was not evaluation-only feature inference")
+    result = aligned({"prediction": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}, groups, split_sha256)
+    if isinstance(result, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: {result}")
+    array, order = result
+    prediction = Lazy(array, order).load()
+    if prediction.shape != (len(groups), 20_000, 2) or not np.isfinite(prediction).all():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: invalid prediction shape or non-finite output")
+    return prediction, {
+        "path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256(path),
+        "sidecar_sha256": sha256(sidecar_path),
+        "membership_sha256": sidecar.get("evaluation_membership_sha256"),
+    }
+
+
+def _score_pair(
+    targets: np.ndarray,
+    mask: np.ndarray,
+    active: np.ndarray,
+    control: np.ndarray,
+    components: np.ndarray,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Compute matched official WP, component uncertainty, and fixed position bins."""
+    active_score = score(targets, mask, active)
+    control_score = score(targets, mask, control)
+    active_moments, control_moments = paired_component_moments(targets, active, control, mask)
+    bootstrap = paired_component_bootstrap(
+        active_moments,
+        control_moments,
+        components,
+        n_boot=BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS,
+        seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
+        centered=True,
+    )
+    bins: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for start, end in TIME_BINS:
+        bin_mask = mask.copy()
+        bin_mask[:, :start] = False
+        bin_mask[:, end:] = False
+        active_bin = score(targets, bin_mask, active)
+        control_bin = score(targets, bin_mask, control)
+        bins[f"{start}:{end}"] = {
+            "active": active_bin,
+            "zero_control": control_bin,
+            "delta": active_bin["wp"] - control_bin["wp"],
+            "scored_rows": int(bin_mask.sum()),
+        }
+    return {
+        "active": active_score,
+        "zero_control": control_score,
+        "delta": active_score["wp"] - control_score["wp"],
+        "paired_component_bootstrap": bootstrap,
+        "time_bins": bins,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Grade both frozen predictions and save the immutable result receipt."""
+    split_bytes = SPLIT_PATH.read_bytes()
+    split = json.loads(split_bytes)
+    split_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(split_bytes).hexdigest()
+    groups = [int(group) for group in split["evaluation"]["valid"]]
+    if len(groups) != 468:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected 468 F0 evaluation groups, found {len(groups)}")
+    component_by_group = {
+        int(row["row_group"]): int(row["component"]) for row in split["sequences"]["valid"]
+    }
+    components = np.asarray([component_by_group[group] for group in groups], dtype=np.int64)
+    if len(np.unique(components)) < 100:
+        raise ValueError("unexpectedly few evaluation components for the fixed F0 panel")
+
+    active, active_identity = _load_prediction(ACTIVE, groups, split_sha256)
+    control, control_identity = _load_prediction(CONTROL, groups, split_sha256)
+    with np.load(TARGETS_PATH, allow_pickle=False) as cache:
+        position = {int(group): index for index, group in enumerate(cache["row_group"])}
+        index = [position[group] for group in groups]
+        targets = np.asarray(cache["y"][index], dtype=np.float32)
+        mask = np.asarray(cache["mask"][index], dtype=bool)
+    mask &= np.arange(targets.shape[1])[None, :] >= SCORED_FROM_ROW
+
+    result = {
+        "schema": "wnn.kalman_group_recurrent_interaction_grade.v1",

+"""Grade a frozen recurrent-feature pair on the fixed F0 evaluation panel."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
+
+from grade_prediction_bank import SCORED_FROM_ROW, Lazy, aligned, score, sha256  # noqa: E402
+
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap, paired_component_moments  # noqa: E402
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SPLIT_PATH = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+TARGETS_PATH = ROOT / "cache/valid_targets.npz"
+ACTIVE = "kalman_groupfast_active_f0_s4_r1"
+CONTROL = "kalman_groupfast_zero_f0_s4_r1"
+BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS = 2_000
+BOOTSTRAP_SEED = 20261018
+TIME_BINS = ((99, 500), (500, 2_000), (2_000, 10_000), (10_000, 20_000))
+
+
+def _load_prediction(
+    name: str, groups: list[int], split_sha256: str
+) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load a row-aligned prediction only after validating its feature-only sidecar."""
+    path = ROOT / "cache" / f"pred_{name}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar_path = path.with_suffix(".json")
+    sidecar = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if sidecar.get("campaign_export_scope") != "evaluation" or not sidecar.get("feature_only"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction export was not evaluation-only feature inference")
+    result = aligned({"prediction": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}, groups, split_sha256)
+    if isinstance(result, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: {result}")
+    array, order = result
+    prediction = Lazy(array, order).load()
+    if prediction.shape != (len(groups), 20_000, 2) or not np.isfinite(prediction).all():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: invalid prediction shape or non-finite output")
+    return prediction, {
+        "path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256(path),
+        "sidecar_sha256": sha256(sidecar_path),
+        "membership_sha256": sidecar.get("evaluation_membership_sha256"),
+    }
+
+
+def _score_pair(
+    targets: np.ndarray,
+    mask: np.ndarray,
+    active: np.ndarray,
+    control: np.ndarray,
+    components: np.ndarray,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Compute matched official WP, component uncertainty, and fixed position bins."""
+    active_score = score(targets, mask, active)
+    control_score = score(targets, mask, control)
+    active_moments, control_moments = paired_component_moments(targets, active, control, mask)
+    bootstrap = paired_component_bootstrap(
+        active_moments,
+        control_moments,
+        components,
+        n_boot=BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS,
+        seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
+        centered=True,
+    )
+    bins: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for start, end in TIME_BINS:
+        bin_mask = mask.copy()
+        bin_mask[:, :start] = False
+        bin_mask[:, end:] = False
+        active_bin = score(targets, bin_mask, active)
+        control_bin = score(targets, bin_mask, control)
+        bins[f"{start}:{end}"] = {
+            "active": active_bin,
+            "zero_control": control_bin,
+            "delta": active_bin["wp"] - control_bin["wp"],
+            "scored_rows": int(bin_mask.sum()),
+        }
+    return {
+        "active": active_score,
+        "zero_control": control_score,
+        "delta": active_score["wp"] - control_score["wp"],
+        "paired_component_bootstrap": bootstrap,
+        "time_bins": bins,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Grade both frozen predictions and save the immutable result receipt."""
+    split_bytes = SPLIT_PATH.read_bytes()
+    split = json.loads(split_bytes)
+    split_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(split_bytes).hexdigest()
+    freeze_path = PACKET / "prediction_freeze_seed4_r1.json"
+    freeze = json.loads(freeze_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if (
+        freeze.get("experiment_id") != "E-KALMAN-GROUP-RECURRENT-SEED4-20261018-R1"
+        or freeze.get("status") != "frozen_feature_only_predictions_ready_for_official_grade"
+        or freeze.get("targets_read") is not False
+        or freeze.get("masks_read") is not False
+        or freeze.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("seed-4 prediction freeze does not authorize this grade")
+    frozen_predictions = {row["run"]: row for row in freeze.get("predictions", [])}
+    if set(frozen_predictions) != {ACTIVE, CONTROL}:
+        raise ValueError("seed-4 freeze must bind exactly the active/control prediction pair")
+    groups = [int(group) for group in split["evaluation"]["valid"]]
+    if len(groups) != 468:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected 468 F0 evaluation groups, found {len(groups)}")
+    component_by_group = {
+        int(row["row_group"]): int(row["component"]) for row in split["sequences"]["valid"]
+    }
+    components = np.asarray([component_by_group[group] for group in groups], dtype=np.int64)
+    if len(np.unique(components)) < 100:
+        raise ValueError("unexpectedly few evaluation components for the fixed F0 panel")
+
+    active, active_identity = _load_prediction(ACTIVE, groups, split_sha256)
+    control, control_identity = _load_prediction(CONTROL, groups, split_sha256)
+    for run, identity in ((ACTIVE, active_identity), (CONTROL, control_identity)):
+        frozen = frozen_predictions[run]
+        if (
+            frozen.get("prediction_sha256") != identity["sha256"]
+            or frozen.get("sidecar_sha256") != identity["sidecar_sha256"]
+            or frozen.get("prediction_path") != identity["path"]
+            or frozen.get("evaluation_membership_sha256") != identity["membership_sha256"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"{run}: prediction no longer matches the pre-grade freeze")
+    with np.load(TARGETS_PATH, allow_pickle=False) as cache:
+        position = {int(group): index for index, group in enumerate(cache["row_group"])}
+        index = [position[group] for group in groups]
+        targets = np.asarray(cache["y"][index], dtype=np.float32)
+        mask = np.asarray(cache["mask"][index], dtype=bool)
+    mask &= np.arange(targets.shape[1])[None, :] >= SCORED_FROM_ROW
+
+    result = {
+        "schema": "wnn.kalman_group_recurrent_interaction_grade.v1",
+        "experiment_id": "E-KALMAN-GROUP-RECURRENT-SEED4-20261018-R1",
+        "hypothesis_id": "H-KALMAN-GROUP-RECURRENT-INTERACTION-20261018-R1",
+        "metric_id": "global_wp_clip2_v1",
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_sha256,
+        "groups": len(groups),
+        "unique_components": int(len(np.unique(components))),
+        "mask": f"cached is_scored AND position >= {SCORED_FROM_ROW}; predictions frozen before target/mask access",
+        "prediction_identity": {"active": active_identity, "zero_control": control_identity},
+        "checkpoint_identity": {
+            run: frozen_predictions[run]["checkpoint_sha256"] for run in (ACTIVE, CONTROL)
+        },
+        "prediction_freeze": {
+            "path": freeze_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256(freeze_path),
+        },
+        "comparison": _score_pair(targets, mask, active, control, components),
+        "bootstrap": {
+            "unit": "source-qualified connected evaluation component",
+            "draws": BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS,
+            "seed": BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
+            "scope": "conditional on these two fixed checkpoints and the repeatedly inspected F0 panel; excludes fit-seed, fold, and public-transfer uncertainty",
+            "timing": "computed in this grade after the seed-4 prediction pair was frozen; no seed-4 score was inspected before target/mask access",
+        },
+        "exposure": "F0 is repeatedly inspected development evidence, not clean validation",
+    }
+    result["source_sha256"] = {
+        "script": sha256(Path(__file__)),
+        "split": sha256(SPLIT_PATH),
+        "targets_cache": sha256(TARGETS_PATH),
+        "prediction_freeze": sha256(freeze_path),
+    }
+    output = PACKET / "grade_result_seed4_r1.json"
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to overwrite {output}")
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps(result["comparison"], indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Profile causality and batch/stream parity on one fitting-side input sequence."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from wnn.data import SequenceFile  # noqa: E402
+from wnn.kalman_group_features import (  # noqa: E402
+    FEATURE_WIDTH,
+    StreamingKalmanGroupFeatures,
+    features_numpy,
+    features_torch,
+    features_torch_step,
+    initial_stream_state_torch,
+)
+
+SOURCE_GROUP = 6768
+SOURCE_COMPONENT = 2406
+REFERENCE_DIR = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-10-18/online_features_r1/group_fast_slow_r1"
+sys.path.insert(0, str(REFERENCE_DIR))
+from group_features import extract_online_features  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def _stream_numpy(sequence: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    state = StreamingKalmanGroupFeatures()
+    return np.stack([state.update(row) for row in sequence])
+
+
+def _stream_torch(sequence: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    state = initial_stream_state_torch()
+    outputs = []
+    for row in sequence:
+        features, state = features_torch_step(torch.from_numpy(row[None].copy()), state)
+        outputs.append(features[0].numpy())
+    return np.stack(outputs)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    source = ROOT / "datasets/train.parquet"
+    sequence = SequenceFile(source).read(SOURCE_GROUP, targets=False, mask=False).features
+    batch = torch.from_numpy(sequence[None].copy())
+
+    numpy_features = features_numpy(sequence)
+    _, _, reference_features = extract_online_features(sequence)
+    batch_features = features_torch(batch)[0].numpy()
+    streamed_numpy = _stream_numpy(sequence)
+    streamed_torch = _stream_torch(sequence)
+
+    prefix_end = 10_000
+    perturbed = sequence.copy()
+    perturbed[prefix_end:] = perturbed[prefix_end:] + np.float32(0.25)
+    future_features = features_numpy(perturbed)
+    repeat_stream = StreamingKalmanGroupFeatures()
+    first_pass = np.stack([repeat_stream.update(row) for row in sequence])
+    repeat_stream.reset()
+    reset_pass = np.stack([repeat_stream.update(row) for row in sequence])
+
+    batch_delta = np.abs(batch_features - numpy_features)
+    batch_max_index = np.unravel_index(int(np.argmax(batch_delta)), batch_delta.shape)
+    torch_stream_delta = np.abs(streamed_torch - batch_features)
+    torch_stream_max_index = np.unravel_index(
+        int(np.argmax(torch_stream_delta)), torch_stream_delta.shape
+    )
+    detail_row = int(batch_max_index[0])
+    detail_group = int(batch_max_index[1] % 13)
+    detail_indices = (detail_group, 13 + detail_group, 26 + detail_group)
+    metrics = {
+        "schema": "wnn.kalman_group_feature_preflight.v1",
+        "source": {
+            "split": "train",
+            "row_group": SOURCE_GROUP,
+            "component": SOURCE_COMPONENT,
+            "rows": int(len(sequence)),
+            "features": int(sequence.shape[1]),
+            "targets_read": False,
+            "masks_read": False,
+            "features_sha256": hashlib.sha256(sequence.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        },
+        "feature_width": FEATURE_WIDTH,
+        "implementation_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            (ROOT / "src/wnn/kalman_group_features.py").read_bytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "reference_implementation_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            (REFERENCE_DIR / "group_features.py").read_bytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "finite": bool(np.isfinite(numpy_features).all() and np.isfinite(batch_features).all()),
+        "reference_recipe_max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(reference_features - numpy_features[99:]))),
+        "batch_vs_numpy_max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(batch_features - numpy_features))),
+        "batch_vs_numpy_max_index": [int(index) for index in batch_max_index],
+        "batch_vs_numpy_values": [
+            float(batch_features[batch_max_index]),
+            float(numpy_features[batch_max_index]),
+        ],
+        "batch_vs_numpy_detail_row_features": {
+            str(index): [
+                float(batch_features[detail_row, index]),
+                float(numpy_features[detail_row, index]),
+            ]
+            for index in detail_indices
+        },
+        "batch_vs_numpy_max_by_feature_block": [
+            float(np.max(batch_delta[:, start:end])) for start, end in ((0, 13), (13, 26), (26, 39))
+        ],
+        "numpy_stream_vs_batch_max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(streamed_numpy - numpy_features))),
+        "torch_stream_vs_batch_max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(streamed_torch - batch_features))),
+        "torch_stream_vs_batch_max_index": [int(index) for index in torch_stream_max_index],
+        "future_perturbation_prefix_max_abs": float(
+            np.max(np.abs(future_features[:prefix_end] - numpy_features[:prefix_end]))
+        ),
+        "reset_repeat_max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(reset_pass - first_pass))),
+        "warmup_prefix_nonzero_count": int(np.count_nonzero(numpy_features[:99])),
+        "all_zero_control_nonzero_count": int(
+            np.count_nonzero(features_numpy(sequence, control="all"))
+        ),
+    }
+    result = json.dumps(metrics, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
+    (Path(__file__).parent / "preflight_result_r1.json").write_text(result)
+    print(result, end="")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Exposed F0 prediction geometry diagnostic
+
+## Question or claim
+
+How do five already-frozen predictors and their corrections relate to the
+parent on source-qualified fold0, including the four position ranges declared
+before looking at the labels? This is a diagnostic geometry report for later
+independent review. It is not a clean evaluation or a deployment decision.
+
+## Mechanism and method
+
+The panel has 468 evaluation sequences, 141 source-qualified components, and
+808,863 rows selected by the official target-cache mask after warmup position
+99. Every prediction was aligned to `evaluation.valid` through sidecar
+`row_group` IDs. The evaluator used `global_wp_clip2_v1`, clipped labels and
+predictions at ±2, and the original weight `abs(clipped label)`. It did not
+send labels or the mask to a predictor.
+
+The frozen set was the F0 parent, R2 full geometry, R2 `m0p50` fixed inference
+alias, R3 moments-only, and R3 dictionary-only. There are 37,742 selected rows
+in `[99,1000)`, 159,998 in `[1000,5000)`, 198,988 in `[5000,10000)`, and 412,135
+in `[10000,20000)`. Bin panel coverage and per-target weighted mass are:
+
+| Position range | Selected rows | Sequences | Components | Weight mass t0 | Weight mass t1 |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| `[99,1000)` | 37,742 | 435 | 136 | 25,922.2894 | 28,451.1414 |
+| `[1000,5000)` | 159,998 | 466 | 140 | 110,252.1998 | 114,278.9341 |
+| `[5000,10000)` | 198,988 | 468 | 141 | 142,803.5798 | 143,659.0496 |
+| `[10000,20000)` | 412,135 | 468 | 141 | 282,265.5731 | 288,925.6860 |
+
+For each target, the receipt contains weighted covariance and correlation for
+clipped candidate prediction vs parent, parent-relative correction vs parent,
+and correction vs label. It also reports the correlation of correction and
+label residuals after each was projected on the fixed parent using a pooled
+F0 weighted intercept and slope. The pooled coefficients are reused in every
+bin; there are no bin-specific refits.
+
+## Evidence and interpretation
+
+All five recomputed pooled scores match the frozen independent grade within
+`2e-6` (the observed differences are at floating-point roundoff). Pooled
+official scores are primary; the position bins are diagnostics only.
+
+| Predictor | Pooled WP | t0 | t1 | Δ WP vs parent | `[99,1000)` | `[1000,5000)` | `[5000,10000)` | `[10000,20000)` |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| Parent | 0.681226513 | 0.674220742 | 0.688232284 | — | 0.677936 | 0.688169 | 0.650104 | 0.694939 |
+| R2 full geometry | 0.680449904 | 0.673181545 | 0.687718263 | -0.000776609 | 0.677841 | 0.687543 | 0.649232 | 0.694095 |
+| R2 `m0p50` alias | 0.681422110 | 0.674531852 | 0.688312368 | +0.000195597 | 0.677910 | 0.688286 | 0.650306 | 0.695175 |
+| R3 moments-only | 0.680868024 | 0.673798572 | 0.687937477 | -0.000358489 | 0.678242 | 0.687753 | 0.649690 | 0.694574 |
+| R3 dictionary-only | 0.680616866 | 0.673417560 | 0.687816172 | -0.000609647 | 0.677962 | 0.687630 | 0.649350 | 0.694315 |
+
+The per-bin `t0 / t1` scores, in the same bin order, are:
+
+| Predictor | `[99,1000)` | `[1000,5000)` | `[5000,10000)` | `[10000,20000)` |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| Parent | 0.642964 / 0.712908 | 0.662912 / 0.713426 | 0.646669 / 0.653539 | 0.696885 / 0.692992 |
+| R2 full geometry | 0.643476 / 0.712207 | 0.662459 / 0.712626 | 0.645254 / 0.653211 | 0.695685 / 0.692504 |
+| R2 `m0p50` alias | 0.642581 / 0.713240 | 0.663012 / 0.713559 | 0.647122 / 0.653489 | 0.697256 / 0.693094 |
+| R3 moments-only | 0.643690 / 0.712794 | 0.662774 / 0.712732 | 0.645974 / 0.653407 | 0.696397 / 0.692750 |
+| R3 dictionary-only | 0.643363 / 0.712561 | 0.662466 / 0.712794 | 0.645558 / 0.653141 | 0.696005 / 0.692626 |
+
+The scale alias's within-panel WP difference ranges from `-0.000026` in the
+earliest bin to `+0.000236` in the latest. This describes the fixed predictions
+on this exposed panel only; it does not establish a gradient effect, explain a
+cause, or support generalization. No inference is drawn from the sign changes
+for the fitted R2/R3 variants either.
+
+The candidates remain very close to the parent in weighted prediction geometry:
+pooled prediction-parent correlations are about `0.9996`–`0.9999`. Their
+corrections have weighted parent-projection R² from `0.573` to `0.748` across
+the two targets and four non-parent candidates. After the fixed pooled-F0
+parent projections, pooled correction-residual / target-residual correlations
+are small, from approximately `-0.039` to `+0.037`. These are descriptive
+same-panel relationships and use exposed labels; they are not evidence that a
+correction is redundant or that residual signal transfers. Full pooled and
+per-bin covariances, correlations, and projection coefficients are in
+[receipt.json](receipt.json).
+
+## Limits and validity
+
+Fold0 has been inspected repeatedly and is not a fresh holdout. This report
+adds no bootstrap, model fit, prediction replay, alpha search, or coefficient
+selection. The R2 scale alias is an inference-only derivative of the R2
+checkpoint, not an independent fit. Prediction hashes and sidecar hashes are
+reused from the frozen grade rather than recomputed. Unknown TL3 training,
+teacher, initializer, and sequence ancestry remains unknown; TL3 was not added
+to this grid. No venue, clock, event, market cause, or online-learning rule is
+inferred from these anonymous sequence positions or labels.
+
+## Decision and next step
+
+No SHIP/KILL judgment is made. Pass the receipt to the independent MFT skeptic
+for interpretation alongside the experiment's causal contract and ancestry.
+Treat any position pattern as an exposed-F0 diagnostic, and retain the
+component-clean F0 parent as the comparison reference.
+

+# Frozen F0 prediction geometry
+
+This folder records a bounded offline comparison of five frozen F0 prediction
+caches for campaign `C-ONLINE-FEATURES-20261018-R1`: the component-clean F0
+parent, R2 full geometry, the fixed R2 `m0p50` inference alias, R3 moments-only,
+and R3 dictionary-only. It measures where their clipped predictions and parent-relative
+corrections overlap on the repeatedly exposed F0 panel. It does not make a
+quality, deployment, or causal claim.
+
+- [GEOMETRY.md](GEOMETRY.md) reports pooled and predeclared position-bin scores,
+  panel coverage, weighted prediction geometry, and limits for a later
+  independent MFT skeptic.
+- [receipt.json](receipt.json) contains machine-readable scores, weighted
+  covariances/correlations, fixed-parent projection diagnostics, bin counts,
+  label-weight mass, and source hashes.
+- [geometry_diagnostic.py](geometry_diagnostic.py) is the small read-only
+  offline grader. It aligns only by source `row_group` IDs, uses the official
+  metric helper, and checks pooled scores against the frozen independent grade.
+
+Inputs are `cache/valid_targets.npz`, the five prediction caches and sidecars
+named in the receipt, fold0 at
+`research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json`, and the previously

+"""Offline weighted geometry for five frozen, exposed-F0 prediction caches."""

+import hashlib
+import json

+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any  # JSON metadata has heterogeneous nested values.
+
+import numpy as np

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
+from wnn.gmetric import GlobalAccumulator  # noqa: E402
+
+SPLIT = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+TARGETS = ROOT / "cache/valid_targets.npz"
+GRADE = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-10-18/geometry_variations_r3/geometry_r3_grade.json"
+OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "receipt.json"
+STEPS = 20_000
+BINS = {
+    "pos_99_1000": (99, 1_000),
+    "pos_1000_5000": (1_000, 5_000),
+    "pos_5000_10000": (5_000, 10_000),
+    "pos_10000_20000": (10_000, 20_000),
+}
+SCOPES = {"pooled_scored": (99, STEPS), **BINS}
+MODELS = {
+    "parent": "warm_mechanism_f0_s3_c_r3",
+    "r2_full_geometry": "geometry_adapter_f0_s3_r2",
+    "r2_scale_m0p50": "geometry_adapter_f0_s3_r2_scale_a_m0p50",
+    "r3_moments_only": "geometry_variation_f0_s3_r3_moments_only",
+    "r3_dictionary_only": "geometry_variation_f0_s3_r3_dictionary_only",
+}
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a small manifest or receipt in bounded blocks."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def weighted_pair(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, weight: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float | None]:
+    """Summarize weighted covariance and correlation over positive-weight rows."""
+    selected = weight > 0
+    if not selected.any():
+        return {"weight": 0.0, "covariance": None, "correlation": None}
+    x = np.asarray(x[selected], dtype=np.float64)
+    y = np.asarray(y[selected], dtype=np.float64)
+    w = np.asarray(weight[selected], dtype=np.float64)
+    total = float(w.sum())
+    mean_x, mean_y = float(np.sum(w * x) / total), float(np.sum(w * y) / total)
+    dx, dy = x - mean_x, y - mean_y
+    var_x = float(np.sum(w * dx * dx) / total)
+    var_y = float(np.sum(w * dy * dy) / total)
+    covariance = float(np.sum(w * dx * dy) / total)
+    denominator = np.sqrt(var_x * var_y)
+    correlation = None if denominator <= 1e-15 else float(covariance / denominator)
+    return {
+        "weight": total,
+        "mean_x": mean_x,
+        "mean_y": mean_y,
+        "variance_x": var_x,
+        "variance_y": var_y,
+        "covariance": covariance,
+        "correlation": correlation,
+    }
+
+
+def projection(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, weight: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float | None]:
+    """Fit a weighted intercept and slope for one descriptive fixed projection."""
+    pair = weighted_pair(x, y, weight)
+    var_x = float(pair.get("variance_x") or 0.0)
+    var_y = float(pair.get("variance_y") or 0.0)
+    covariance = float(pair.get("covariance") or 0.0)
+    mean_x = float(pair.get("mean_x") or 0.0)
+    mean_y = float(pair.get("mean_y") or 0.0)
+    slope = covariance / var_x if var_x > 0 else 0.0
+    return {
+        "intercept": mean_y - slope * mean_x,
+        "slope": slope,
+        "weighted_r2": covariance * covariance / (var_x * var_y)
+        if var_x > 0 and var_y > 0
+        else None,
+        "weight": pair["weight"],
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    split = json.loads(SPLIT.read_text())
+    groups = [int(group) for group in split["evaluation"]["valid"]]
+    components_all = {
+        int(row["row_group"]): int(row["component"]) for row in split["sequences"]["valid"]
+    }
+    components = np.asarray([components_all[group] for group in groups], dtype=np.int64)
+    split_sha = sha256(SPLIT)
+    if int(split["fold"]) != 0 or len(groups) != 468 or len(set(groups)) != 468:
+        raise ValueError("fold0 evaluation group identity or size changed")
+    if len(np.unique(components)) != 141:
+        raise ValueError("fold0 evaluation component count changed")
+
+    grade = json.loads(GRADE.read_text())
+    if grade.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha:
+        raise ValueError("frozen grade and fold0 split hashes disagree")
+    with np.load(TARGETS, allow_pickle=False) as archive:
+        target_groups = np.asarray(archive["row_group"], dtype=np.int64)
+        target_position = {int(group): i for i, group in enumerate(target_groups)}
+        if len(target_position) != len(target_groups):
+            raise ValueError("duplicate target-cache row_group")
+        target_indices = [target_position[group] for group in groups]
+        full_y = archive["y"]
+        full_mask = archive["mask"]
+        y = np.asarray(full_y[target_indices], dtype=np.float32)
+        mask = np.asarray(full_mask[target_indices], dtype=bool)
+        del full_y, full_mask
+    if y.shape != (len(groups), STEPS, 2) or mask.shape != (len(groups), STEPS):
+        raise ValueError(f"unexpected target/mask shapes: {y.shape}/{mask.shape}")
+    mask &= np.arange(STEPS)[None, :] >= 99
+    y_clipped = np.clip(y, -2.0, 2.0)
+    weights = np.abs(y_clipped)
+
+    predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
+    identities: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for name, run in MODELS.items():
+        model = grade["candidates"][name]
+        path = ROOT / "cache" / f"pred_{run}_valid.npy"
+        sidecar = json.loads(path.with_suffix(".json").read_text())
+        if sidecar.get("run") != run or sidecar.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction run or split identity mismatch")
+        declared = [int(group) for group in sidecar["row_groups"]]
+        if len(set(declared)) != len(declared) or len(declared) not in (468, 1873):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: unexpected sidecar row groups")
+        position = {group: index for index, group in enumerate(declared)}
+        if any(group not in position for group in groups):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: prediction cache misses evaluation groups")
+        mapped = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+        if mapped.shape != (len(declared), STEPS, 2) or mapped.dtype != np.float32:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: unexpected prediction shape or dtype")
+        if sidecar.get("checkpoint_sha256") != model["producer_checkpoint_sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: producer checkpoint differs from frozen grade")
+        source_sha = model.get("source_checkpoint_sha256")
+        if source_sha and sidecar.get("source_checkpoint_sha256") not in (None, source_sha):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}: source checkpoint differs from frozen grade")
+        predictions[name] = np.clip(
+            np.asarray(mapped[[position[group] for group in groups]], dtype=np.float32), -2.0, 2.0
+        )
+        identities[name] = {
+            "run": run,
+            "role": model["role"],
+            "checkpoint_sha256": model["producer_checkpoint_sha256"],
+            "source_checkpoint_sha256": source_sha,
+            "prediction_sha256_from_frozen_grade": model["prediction_sha256"],
+            "sidecar_sha256_from_frozen_grade": model["sidecar_sha256"],
+            "aligned_evaluation_groups": model["aligned_evaluation_groups"],
+        }
+
+    parent = predictions["parent"]
+    target_fits = {
+        f"t{target}": projection(
+            parent[..., target][mask], y_clipped[..., target][mask], weights[..., target][mask]
+        )
+        for target in range(2)
+    }
+    correction_fits = {}
+    for name, prediction in predictions.items():
+        delta = prediction - parent
+        correction_fits[name] = {
+            f"t{target}": projection(
+                parent[..., target][mask], delta[..., target][mask], weights[..., target][mask]
+            )
+            for target in range(2)
+        }
+
+    frozen_scores = {row["name"]: row for row in grade["ranking"]}
+    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for name, prediction in predictions.items():
+        scopes = {}
+        delta = prediction - parent
+        for scope, (start, stop) in SCOPES.items():
+            scope_mask = mask[:, start:stop]
+            accumulator = GlobalAccumulator()
+            accumulator.add(y[:, start:stop], prediction[:, start:stop], scope_mask)
+            score = accumulator.result()
+            if scope == "pooled_scored":
+                prior = frozen_scores[name]
+                if (
+                    max(abs(float(score[key]) - float(prior[key])) for key in ("wp", "t0", "t1"))
+                    > 2e-6
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(f"{name}: pooled score differs from frozen grade")
+            present = np.flatnonzero(scope_mask.any(axis=1))
+            panel = {
+                "selected_rows": int(scope_mask.sum()),
+                "sequence_count": int(len(present)),
+                "component_count": int(len(np.unique(components[present]))),
+                "weighted_mass_t0": float(
+                    np.sum(weights[:, start:stop, 0] * scope_mask, dtype=np.float64)
+                ),
+                "weighted_mass_t1": float(
+                    np.sum(weights[:, start:stop, 1] * scope_mask, dtype=np.float64)
+                ),
+            }
+            panel["weighted_mass_sum_targets"] = (
+                panel["weighted_mass_t0"] + panel["weighted_mass_t1"]
+            )
+            geometry = {}
+            for target in range(2):
+                selected = scope_mask.reshape(-1)
+                yt = y_clipped[:, start:stop, target].reshape(-1)[selected]
+                wt = weights[:, start:stop, target].reshape(-1)[selected]
+                pt = parent[:, start:stop, target].reshape(-1)[selected]
+                ct = prediction[:, start:stop, target].reshape(-1)[selected]
+                dt = delta[:, start:stop, target].reshape(-1)[selected]
+                yfit = target_fits[f"t{target}"]
+                dfit = correction_fits[name][f"t{target}"]
+                y_residual = yt - (float(yfit["intercept"]) + float(yfit["slope"]) * pt)
+                delta_residual = dt - (float(dfit["intercept"]) + float(dfit["slope"]) * pt)
+                geometry[f"t{target}"] = {
+                    "clipped_prediction_vs_parent": weighted_pair(ct, pt, wt),
+                    "correction_vs_parent": weighted_pair(dt, pt, wt),
+                    "correction_vs_target": weighted_pair(dt, yt, wt),
+                    "correction_orthogonal_vs_target_orthogonal": weighted_pair(
+                        delta_residual, y_residual, wt
+                    )
+                    if name != "parent"
+                    else None,
+                }
+            scopes[scope] = {"official_score": score, "panel": panel, "weighted_geometry": geometry}
+        results[name] = {**identities[name], "scopes": scopes}
+
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "wnn.online_features.prediction_geometry.v1",
+        "created_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
+        "scope": "offline prediction geometry only; no model execution, fitting, or coefficient search",
+        "metric": "global_wp_clip2_v1",
+        "clip": [-2.0, 2.0],
+        "weights": "absolute clipped official labels",
+        "mask": "official target-cache mask AND positions >= 99; labels/mask used only by offline grader",
+        "panel": {
+            "fold": 0,
+            "evaluation_groups": len(groups),
+            "components": int(len(np.unique(components))),
+            "total_selected_rows": int(mask.sum()),
+            "exposure": "repeatedly inspected/exposed F0; not a fresh holdout",
+        },
+        "position_bins": {
+            key: {"start_inclusive": lo, "stop_exclusive": hi} for key, (lo, hi) in BINS.items()
+        },
+        "alignment": "fold0 evaluation.valid row_group IDs matched to target and prediction sidecar row_group IDs",
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_sha,
+        "target_cache": {
+            "path": str(TARGETS.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            "size_bytes": TARGETS.stat().st_size,
+            "row_groups": len(target_groups),
+            "evaluation_y_shape": list(y.shape),

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import struct
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECIPE_PATH = PACKET / "recipe.json"
+FOLD_REL = "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+SPLIT_SHA = "09263ad4fe2b18e2b2f3b79f4562678dce801b067b868134ddc79279f9316a3d"
+INPUT_REL = "datasets/valid.parquet"
+FEATURE_COLUMNS = [
+    f"i{i}_{group}{column}"
+    for i in range(2)
+    for group, width in (("p", 22), ("v", 22), ("dp", 4), ("dv", 4))
+    for column in range(width)
+] + [f"a{i}" for i in range(8)]
+FEATURE_GROUPS = (
+    ("i0_bid_price_like", 0, 11),
+    ("i0_ask_price_like", 11, 22),
+    ("i0_bid_volume_like", 22, 33),
+    ("i0_ask_volume_like", 33, 44),
+    ("i0_trade_price", 44, 48),
+    ("i0_trade_volume", 48, 52),
+    ("i1_bid_price_like", 52, 63),
+    ("i1_ask_price_like", 63, 74),
+    ("i1_bid_volume_like", 74, 85),
+    ("i1_ask_volume_like", 85, 96),
+    ("i1_trade_price", 96, 100),
+    ("i1_trade_volume", 100, 104),
+    ("additional", 104, 112),
+)
+MAX_FOOTER_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
+EXPECTED_GROUPS = 468
+SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 20_000
+WARMUP = 99
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file incrementally without loading its payload into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def parquet_footer_size(path: Path) -> int:
+    """Read the fixed-size Parquet trailer before asking Arrow to parse metadata."""
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        stream.seek(-8, 2)
+        trailer = stream.read(8)
+    if len(trailer) != 8 or trailer[4:] != b"PAR1":
+        raise ValueError(f"{path} does not end with a valid Parquet trailer")
+    return struct.unpack("<I", trailer[:4])[0]
+
+
+def feature_vector(values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Summarize each declared input group using only its first 99 rows."""
+    output = np.empty((len(FEATURE_GROUPS), 3), dtype=np.float32)
+    for index, (_, start, end) in enumerate(FEATURE_GROUPS):
+        part = np.asarray(values[:, start:end], dtype=np.float64)
+        scale = float(part.std())
+        early = float(part[:20].mean())
+        late = float(part[-20:].mean())
+        output[index] = (float(part.mean()), np.log1p(scale), (late - early) / max(scale, 1e-6))
+    return output.reshape(-1)
+
+
+def extract(root: Path, output_dir: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Extract label-blind group summaries for the fixed F0 evaluation sequences."""
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    output_dir = output_dir.resolve()
+    approved_scratch = Path("/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp").resolve(strict=True)
+    if not output_dir.is_relative_to(approved_scratch):
+        raise ValueError(f"output directory must be under {approved_scratch}")
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    feature_path = output_dir / "warmup_features.npy"
+    receipt_path = output_dir / "warmup_features_receipt.json"
+    if feature_path.exists() or receipt_path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError("refusing to overwrite an existing warmup feature artifact")
+
+    split_path = root / FOLD_REL
+    if sha256_file(split_path) != SPLIT_SHA:
+        raise ValueError("F0 split manifest hash differs from the frozen recipe")
+    split = json.loads(split_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    groups = [int(group) for group in split["evaluation"]["valid"]]
+    if len(groups) != EXPECTED_GROUPS or len(set(groups)) != EXPECTED_GROUPS:
+        raise ValueError("unexpected F0 group membership")
+    sequences = {int(row["row_group"]): row for row in split["sequences"]["valid"]}
+
+    recipe = json.loads(RECIPE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    expected_input = recipe["valid_input_source"]
+    parquet_path = root / INPUT_REL
+    if parquet_path.stat().st_size != expected_input["size_bytes"]:
+        raise ValueError("validation Parquet size differs from the frozen recipe")
+    footer_bytes = parquet_footer_size(parquet_path)
+    if footer_bytes != expected_input["footer_metadata_bytes"]:
+        raise ValueError("validation Parquet footer size differs from the frozen recipe")
+    if footer_bytes > MAX_FOOTER_BYTES:
+        raise MemoryError(f"Parquet footer is {footer_bytes} bytes; limit is {MAX_FOOTER_BYTES}")
+    parquet_file = pq.ParquetFile(parquet_path, memory_map=True)
+    if parquet_file.metadata.num_row_groups != expected_input["row_groups"]:
+        raise ValueError("validation Parquet row-group count differs from the bounded profile")
+    if parquet_file.schema.names[:2] != ["seq_ix", "step_in_seq"]:
+        raise ValueError("validation Parquet columns differ from the expected input schema")
+    if any(
+        parquet_file.metadata.row_group(group).num_rows != expected_input["rows_per_group"]
+        for group in groups
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("an evaluation row group is not one complete 20,000-row sequence")
+
+    features = np.empty((EXPECTED_GROUPS, len(FEATURE_GROUPS) * 3), dtype=np.float32)
+    sequence_ids: list[int] = []
+    input_digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for row, group in enumerate(groups):
+        expected_sequence = sequences[group]
+        batches = parquet_file.iter_batches(
+            batch_size=WARMUP,
+            row_groups=[group],
+            columns=["seq_ix", "step_in_seq", *FEATURE_COLUMNS],
+            use_threads=False,
+        )
+        try:
+            batch = next(batches)
+        except StopIteration as error:
+            raise ValueError(f"empty warmup batch for row group {group}") from error
+        sequence_column = batch.column(batch.schema.get_field_index("seq_ix")).to_numpy()
+        position_column = batch.column(batch.schema.get_field_index("step_in_seq")).to_numpy()
+        if len(batch) != WARMUP or set(map(int, sequence_column)) != {
+            int(expected_sequence["seq_ix"])
+        }:
+            raise ValueError(f"row group {group} does not match its frozen sequence identity")
+        if not np.array_equal(position_column, np.arange(WARMUP)):
+            raise ValueError(f"row group {group} does not begin at warmup position zero")
+        matrix = np.column_stack(
+            [
+                batch.column(batch.schema.get_field_index(name)).to_numpy()
+                for name in FEATURE_COLUMNS
+            ]
+        ).astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+        if matrix.shape != (WARMUP, 112) or not np.isfinite(matrix).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid warmup feature matrix for row group {group}")
+        input_digest.update(struct.pack("<qq", group, int(expected_sequence["seq_ix"])))
+        input_digest.update(np.asarray(sequence_column, dtype="<i8").tobytes())
+        input_digest.update(np.asarray(position_column, dtype="<i8").tobytes())
+        input_digest.update(np.asarray(matrix, dtype="<f4", order="C").tobytes())
+        features[row] = feature_vector(matrix)
+        sequence_ids.append(int(sequence_column[0]))
+        del batches
+
+    input_slice_sha256 = input_digest.hexdigest()
+    expected_slice_sha256 = expected_input.get("warmup_slice_sha256")
+    if expected_slice_sha256 is not None and input_slice_sha256 != expected_slice_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("selected warmup input bytes differ from the frozen recipe")
+
+    np.save(feature_path, features, allow_pickle=False)
+    receipt: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema": "wnn.warmup_expert_gate.features.v1",
+        "created_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
+        "recipe_sha256": sha256_file(RECIPE_PATH),
+        "split_manifest": FOLD_REL,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": SPLIT_SHA,
+        "fold": 0,
+        "exposure": "repeatedly exposed F0; label-blind extraction only",
+        "input": {
+            "path": INPUT_REL,
+            "size_bytes": parquet_path.stat().st_size,
+            "footer_metadata_bytes": footer_bytes,
+            "row_groups": parquet_file.metadata.num_row_groups,
+            "rows_per_group": SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
+            "warmup_slice_sha256": input_slice_sha256,
+            "columns_read": ["seq_ix", "step_in_seq", *FEATURE_COLUMNS],
+            "feature_rows_read": len(groups) * WARMUP,
+            "targets_or_masks_read": False,
+        },
+        "membership": {
+            "row_groups": groups,
+            "sequence_ids": sequence_ids,
+            "row_group_order_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+                json.dumps(groups, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")
+            ).hexdigest(),
+        },
+        "features": {
+            "path": str(feature_path),
+            "shape": list(features.shape),
+            "dtype": str(features.dtype),
+            "groups": [name for name, _, _ in FEATURE_GROUPS],
+            "statistics_per_group": ["mean", "log1p_std", "normalized_first20_to_last20_drift"],
+            "sha256": sha256_file(feature_path),
+        },
+        "source_sha256": sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+    }
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return receipt
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run the bounded, target-free warmup feature extraction."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    receipt = extract(args.root, args.output_dir)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {"status": "features_extracted", "feature_sha256": receipt["features"]["sha256"]}
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(

+def verify_run_membership(
+    root: Path,
+    split: dict[str, object],
+    groups: list[int],
+    split_sha: str,
+    provenance_path: str,
+    expected_sha256: str,
+    name: str,
+    expected_checkpoint: tuple[str, str] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object]]:
+    """Verify one run's frozen source-qualified fit/evaluation membership and checkpoint."""
+    path = root / provenance_path
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected_sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} provenance differs from the frozen recipe")
+    provenance = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if provenance.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} was fitted with a different split manifest")
+
+    expected_fit = cast(dict[str, list[int]], split["fit"])
+    observed_fit = cast(dict[str, list[int]], provenance["fit_row_groups"])
+    if set(observed_fit) != set(expected_fit):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} fit membership sources differ from the frozen split")
+    for source, expected_groups in expected_fit.items():
+        observed = [int(value) for value in observed_fit[source]]
+        if len(observed) != len(set(observed)) or set(observed) != set(expected_groups):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} {source} fit groups differ from the frozen split")
+    evaluation_groups = [int(value) for value in provenance["evaluation_row_groups"]]
+    if len(evaluation_groups) != len(set(evaluation_groups)) or set(evaluation_groups) != set(
+        groups
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} evaluation groups differ from the scored F0 panel")
+    if set(expected_fit["valid"]) & set(groups):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} fitted on one or more scored F0 validation groups")
+
+    valid_identity = provenance.get("fit_membership_identity", {}).get("valid", {})
+    expected_identity = cast(
+        dict[str, object], json.loads(RECIPE_PATH.read_text())["fit_membership_identity"]["valid"]
+    )
+    if valid_identity != expected_identity:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} validation fit-membership identity differs from the frozen recipe"
+        )
+    checkpoint_receipt: dict[str, object] = {}
+    if expected_checkpoint is not None:
+        checkpoint_name, checkpoint_sha = expected_checkpoint
+        observed_sha = provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256", {}).get(checkpoint_name)
+        if observed_sha != checkpoint_sha:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} checkpoint hash differs from its run provenance")
+        checkpoint_receipt = {"name": checkpoint_name, "sha256": checkpoint_sha}
+    return provenance, {
+        "run": name,
+        "provenance": provenance_path,
+        "provenance_sha256": expected_sha256,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_sha,
+        "fit_group_counts": {key: len(value) for key, value in observed_fit.items()},
+        "evaluation_group_count": len(evaluation_groups),
+        "checkpoint": checkpoint_receipt,
+    }
+

+    return {

+        "candidate_runs": candidate_receipts,
+        "warm_parent_initializer": initializer_receipt,

+def row_group_components(
+    split: dict[str, object], groups: list[int]
+) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+    """Return source-qualified components and sequence indices in evaluation order."""
+    sequence_splits = cast(dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]], split["sequences"])
+    sequences = sequence_splits["valid"]
+    by_group = {int(row["row_group"]): row for row in sequences}
+    if any(group not in by_group for group in groups):
+        raise ValueError("split is missing a sequence record for an evaluation group")
+    return [int(by_group[group]["component"]) for group in groups], [
+        int(by_group[group]["seq_ix"]) for group in groups
+    ]
+
+
+def grouped_folds(components: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Assign whole source components to four deterministic, balanced folds."""
+    unique = np.array(sorted(set(components)), dtype=np.int64)
+    shuffled = np.random.default_rng(FOLD_SEED).permutation(unique)
+    component_fold = {
+        int(component): fold
+        for fold, block in enumerate(np.array_split(shuffled, N_FOLDS))
+        for component in block
+    }
+    return np.asarray([component_fold[component] for component in components], dtype=np.int8)
+
+
+def output_weights(scores: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Convert predicted per-sequence expert scores to a shrunken simplex gate."""
+    logits = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64) / SOFTMAX_TEMPERATURE
+    logits -= logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
+    probabilities = np.exp(logits)
+    probabilities /= probabilities.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
+    return UNIFORM_SHRINKAGE / scores.shape[1] + (1.0 - UNIFORM_SHRINKAGE) * probabilities
+
+
+def fit_ridge(
+    features: np.ndarray, targets: np.ndarray, train: np.ndarray, test: np.ndarray
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Fit a standardized multi-output ridge map and predict expert utility."""
+    mean = features[train].mean(axis=0)
+    scale = np.maximum(features[train].std(axis=0), 1e-6)
+    x_train = (features[train] - mean) / scale
+    x_test = (features[test] - mean) / scale
+    design_train = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(train)), x_train))
+    design_test = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(test)), x_test))
+    penalty = np.eye(design_train.shape[1], dtype=np.float64) * RIDGE_ALPHA
+    penalty[0, 0] = 0.0
+    beta = np.linalg.solve(design_train.T @ design_train + penalty, design_train.T @ targets[train])
+    return design_test @ beta
+
+
+def get_target(cache: dict[str, np.memmap], index: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Read one sequence's cached target and apply the frozen warmup mask."""
+    target = np.asarray(cache["y"][index], dtype=np.float32)
+    selection = np.asarray(cache["mask"][index], dtype=bool).copy()
+    selection[:WARMUP] = False
+    if target.shape != (20_000, 2) or selection.shape != (20_000,):
+        raise ValueError(f"target-cache sequence {index} has an unexpected shape")
+    return target, selection
+
+
+def one_score(target: np.ndarray, prediction: np.ndarray, selection: np.ndarray) -> float:
+    """Compute official pooled WP on one sequence using the production accumulator."""
+    from wnn.gmetric import GlobalAccumulator
+
+    accumulator = GlobalAccumulator()
+    accumulator.add(target[None], prediction[None], selection[None])
+    return float(accumulator.result()["wp"])
+
+
+def predictions_for_group(arrays: dict[str, PredictionView], index: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Materialize one small group from each memory-mapped expert array."""
+    values = np.stack([array[slice(index, index + 1)][0] for array in arrays.values()])
+    if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+        raise ValueError(f"nonfinite cached predictions at F0 evaluation index {index}")
+    return values
+

+
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))

+    campaign = load_module(

+# Quick causal geometry submission probe
+
+Experiment **E-GEOMETRY-QUICK-PROBE-20261018-R1**. The latest user explicitly supersedes the multi-day local R4 allocation with a few local probes, one newly trained exploratory submission ZIP within two hours, and a draft PR for teammate 8×B300 confirmation.
+
+## What runs locally
+
+One paired short continuation of `warm_mechanism_f0_s3_c_r3@ep1`, a strong H256×2 GRU with 211 raw/event inputs and recorded exposed-F0 WP 0.6812265132. Append 60 causal geometry/exact-level channels with zero input weights, mean zero and scale one; the initial function is preserved apart from floating-point kernel rounding. Compare active features with the same-width zero-suffix control. Each arm uses the same seed 3, eligible component-excluded F0 fitting membership and 4,096 complete-sequence draws with replacement, one epoch, AdamW max LR 3e-5, OneCycle, weight decay .01, gradient clip 1, FP32/TF32 off, fixed epoch 0 and no outer-score checkpoint selection. Parent auxiliary construction is inherited. This is a warm-continuation screen, not a new from-scratch comparison or evidence about teacher/student transfer.
+
+The provisional delivery is a single candidate using the feature arm. Its grade is compared to the matched control and parent; exposed F0 and one fitting seed do not establish significance or robust transfer. A negative or uncertain result is retained as evidence about this short recipe. The server owns wider seed/fold comparisons.
+
+## Files and current status
+
+- [recipe.json](recipe.json) freezes actual commands, fitting unit, scope, budget and interpretation.
+- [run_pair.py](run_pair.py) executes the two serial fits, then full-F0 held-out prediction exports and official grades, preserving phase logs and return codes.
+- [profile_command.json](profile_command.json) and [profile_r1_cli_failure.log](profile_r1_cli_failure.log) preserve a prefit CLI failure: profiling cannot save continuation state; no updates occurred. [Corrected profile command](profile_command_r2.json) removes that incompatible option.
+- [profile_r2.log](profile_r2.log) records 60 finite FP32 optimizer updates, median batch wall 920.28 ms for B8/full20k rows, cgroup peak 3,328,434,176 bytes and CUDA allocated/reserved peaks 662,342,656/1,109,393,408 bytes. This short shape profile is not a quality result or guaranteed long-run timing.
+- [runtime/](runtime/) contains controller attempt receipts. Initial 5 GB admission was rejected because the projected parent commitment exceeded the 17 GB target; no fit started. R2 reserves 4.5 GB, including over 1.16 GB above measured profile peak, one CPU core and no swap, under the unchanged aggregate two-core parent.
+- `progress.jsonl` and `{feature,control}.{train,predict,score}.log` preserve serial execution receipts, training losses/LR/gradient norms, full prediction export logs and official scores as they land. Checkpoints and resume states stay in `artifacts/runs/geometry_quick_f0_s3_{feature,control}/`; predictions and sidecars are in `cache/`. These payload locations are not committed model weights.
+
+## Previous local allocation closed
+
+[The frozen R4 matrix](../../campaign_2026-10-17/geometry_from_scratch_r4/README.md) was stopped at the user's request after roughly 100 batches of the first control and before an epoch checkpoint or quality score. Its logs and controller receipts are preserved, and its admission barrier is closed. It is cancellation for resource scope, not negative scientific evidence.
+
+## Submission and server follow-up
+
+Serving must reconstruct the same 60 causal features and 99 event features, update during warmup, reset between sequences, pass checkpoint/native parity, and fit the ZIP/runtime envelope. Native CPU-policy-D libraries are reused only after checking their actual exported API. Packaging results, measured callback throughput and ZIP hash will be appended here. No public score is predicted from a local delta.
+
+A separate draft PR targets `research-team` with strict FP32 B300 recipes, 30 paired seed/fold cells per scientific arm, component/seed uncertainty, ablations and evidence/weight archive instructions. Its actual URL will be recorded when published.
+
+[October 18 campaign index](../README.md) links this scoped work.
+
+[Independent route review](../../unified/reviews/QUICK_GEOMETRY_ROUTE_REVIEW_20261018_R1.md) verifies the paired design and identifies serving risks before results; it does not approve the eventual artifact.
+
+[User-supplied public reference](public_reference_user_20261018.json) binds the pasted portal names/IDs: tl3 0.66832 in 39m12s, tl4 0.66830 in 50m7s, and CPU-D xteam 0.66808 in 47m27s. It reports 0/5 submissions today and 97 total; timezone and current quota are not independently verified. The new single-GRU probe is not yet expected to beat the mature three-model tl3 ensemble. A fixed contribution to that endpoint is eligible only if actual packaging/runtime and honest evidence support the exploratory release.

+## Delivery deadline and first actual endpoint
+
+[Scope/fit receipt](scope_receipt.json) records the hard delivery deadline: **02:50 Kyiv on October18 /23:50UTC October17**. The feature arm completed all5,120optimizer updates (512batches), with finite gradients, in735.1training seconds. Its checkpoint exists, but prediction/grade remain pending until the serial matched control finishes. The full fit averaged1.436seconds/batch including its cold work; the five-batch0.920-second profile underestimated full-fit wall cost. Do not treat short-profile extrapolations as measured end-to-end costs.

+[compare_pair.py](compare_pair.py) reuses official stable centered component statistics and paired component bootstrap, aligns producer row-group metadata, and checks shared initializer, parameter, fitting-membership, prior and normalization identities. Its eventual comparison JSON distinguishes feature/control from each child/parent continuation and conditions uncertainty on the fixed fits and exposed F0.
+
+[geometry_prior.json](geometry_prior.json) is the checkpoint/provenance-derived fitted prior for selected raw columns0,3,52,55 and all60 feature names. It contains constants and64source-qualified fitting groups, not raw competition rows. It is required in the submission ZIP.

+Hypothesis **H-GEOMETRY-WARM-ZERO-20261018-R1**, child of **H-DISCRETE-OCCUPANCY-20261017-R1**, links this exploratory warm continuation to the earlier discrete/prefix investigation. The mechanism concerns optimization and persistent causal context, with no numerical prior or assumed additive public gain.

+"""Grade the frozen quick pair with existing official component uncertainty tools."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
+
+from grade_prediction_bank import aligned  # noqa: E402
+
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap, paired_component_moments  # noqa: E402
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SPLIT = ROOT / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+
+
+def digest(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash artifacts in bounded chunks."""
+    value = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as source:
+        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            value.update(block)
+    return value.hexdigest()
+
+
+def prediction(name: str, groups: list[int], split_sha: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Require source-qualified producer alignment before reading predictions."""
+    result = aligned({"prediction": f"cache/pred_{name}_valid.npy"}, groups, split_sha)
+    if isinstance(result, str):
+        raise ValueError(result)
+    array, positions = result
+    return np.asarray(array[positions], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Report one exposed-fold paired contrast without a significance claim."""
+    split = json.loads(SPLIT.read_text())
+    groups = split["evaluation"]["valid"]
+    components_by_group = {
+        row["row_group"]: row["component"] for row in split["sequences"]["valid"]
+    }
+    components = np.asarray([components_by_group[group] for group in groups])
+    with np.load(ROOT / "cache/valid_targets.npz", allow_pickle=False) as source:
+        positions = {int(group): index for index, group in enumerate(source["row_group"])}
+        selected = [positions[group] for group in groups]
+        targets = np.asarray(source["y"][selected], dtype=np.float32)
+        mask = np.asarray(source["mask"][selected], dtype=bool)
+    mask[:, :99] = False
+    names = {arm: f"geometry_quick_f0_s3_{arm}" for arm in ("feature", "control")}
+    provenance = {
+        arm: json.loads((ROOT / "artifacts/runs" / name / "provenance.json").read_text())
+        for arm, name in names.items()
+    }
+    matched = (
+        "initial_checkpoint_sha256",
+        "initial_parameter_sha256",
+        "fit_membership_identity",
+        "normalization_identity",
+        "causal_feature_prior",
+        "split_manifest_sha256",
+    )
+    for field in matched:
+        if provenance["feature"].get(field) != provenance["control"].get(field):
+            raise ValueError(f"paired identity mismatch: {field}")
+    histories = {
+        arm: json.loads((ROOT / "artifacts/runs" / name / "history.json").read_text())
+        for arm, name in names.items()
+    }
+    for field in ("epoch", "cumulative", "sample_order_identity"):
+        if (
+            histories["feature"][0]["update_diagnostics"][field]
+            != histories["control"][0]["update_diagnostics"][field]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"paired update/sampler mismatch: {field}")
+    predictions = {arm: prediction(name, groups, digest(SPLIT)) for arm, name in names.items()}
+    predictions["parent"] = prediction("warm_mechanism_f0_s3_c_r3", groups, digest(SPLIT))
+    result = {
+        "experiment_id": "E-GEOMETRY-QUICK-PROBE-20261018-R1",
+        "metric": "global_wp_clip2_v1",
+        "sequences": len(groups),
+        "components": int(len(np.unique(components))),
+        "selected_rows": int(mask.sum()),
+        "matched_fields": list(matched),
+        "comparisons": {},
+        "limitations": "One exposed F0, fitting seed3 and fixed parent. Component intervals condition on fitted endpoints; they do not cover fitting-seed, selection or public-transfer uncertainty. No public score forecast.",
+    }
+    for candidate, reference in (
+        ("feature", "control"),
+        ("feature", "parent"),
+        ("control", "parent"),
+    ):
+        left, right = paired_component_moments(
+            targets, predictions[candidate], predictions[reference], mask
+        )
+        result["comparisons"][f"{candidate}_vs_{reference}"] = paired_component_bootstrap(
+            left, right, components, n_boot=2000, seed=20261018, centered=True
+        )
+    (PACKET / "comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Plot the measured quick-probe training and conditional score contrasts."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import matplotlib
+
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
+import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PATTERN = re.compile(r"^ep 0 batch (\d+)/\d+ loss ([\d.e+-]+)")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Save one self-contained evidence figure after the paired grade lands."""
+    result = json.loads((PACKET / "comparison.json").read_text())
+    figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.4), constrained_layout=True)
+    for arm, color in (("feature", "#2671c6"), ("control", "#d16d26")):
+        points = [
+            match.groups()
+            for line in (PACKET / f"{arm}.train.log").read_text().splitlines()
+            if (match := PATTERN.match(line))
+        ]
+        x = np.asarray([int(point[0]) for point in points]) * 10
+        y = np.asarray([float(point[1]) for point in points])
+        axes[0].plot(x, y, alpha=0.35, color=color)
+        if len(y) >= 5:
+            axes[0].plot(
+                x[4:],
+                np.convolve(y, np.ones(5) / 5, mode="valid"),
+                color=color,
+                label=f"{arm}: 5-point moving mean",
+            )
+    axes[0].set(
+        xlabel="Completed optimizer updates (logged batches)",
+        ylabel="Training loss, including auxiliary terms",
+        title="One short warm continuation per arm",
+    )
+    axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
+    labels = {
+        "feature_vs_control": "Features − zero control",
+        "feature_vs_parent": "Features − parent",
+        "control_vs_parent": "Zero control − parent",
+    }
+    for index, (key, label) in enumerate(labels.items()):
+        contrast = result["comparisons"][key]
+        center = contrast["mean_diff"]
+        lower, upper = contrast["ci95"]
+        axes[1].errorbar(
+            center,
+            index,
+            xerr=[[center - lower], [upper - center]],
+            fmt="o",
+            capsize=4,
+            label=label,
+        )
+    axes[1].axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
+    axes[1].set(
+        yticks=range(3),
+        yticklabels=list(labels.values()),
+        xlabel="Official WP difference",
+        title="Paired component 95% intervals",
+    )
+    axes[1].ticklabel_format(axis="x", style="sci", scilimits=(0, 0))
+    figure.suptitle(
+        f"Exploratory F0, seed 3: {result['sequences']} sequences / {result['components']} components\nIntervals condition on these fixed fits; no seed or public-transfer uncertainty",
+        fontsize=11,
+    )
+    figure.savefig(PACKET / "quick_probe_results.png", dpi=160)
+    plt.close(figure)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
