+"""Run one bounded warm feature/control comparison, then export and grade it."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def record(event: str, **fields: object) -> None:
+    """Append phase receipts without replacing previous evidence."""
+    with (PACKET / "progress.jsonl").open("a") as output:
+        output.write(
+            json.dumps({"event": event, "timestamp_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), **fields})
+            + "\n"
+        )
+
+
+def execute(arm: str, phase: str, command: list[str], timeout: int) -> None:
+    """Execute one serial phase within the shared task resource boundary."""
+    record("phase_start", arm=arm, phase=phase, command=command)
+    with (PACKET / f"{arm}.{phase}.log").open("x") as output:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, check=False
+        )
+    record("phase_end", arm=arm, phase=phase, returncode=result.returncode)
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{arm}/{phase} failed: {result.returncode}")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Fit the feature arm first to ensure the requested model is delivered."""
+    os.environ.update(
+        {
+            "WNN_THREADS": "1",
+            "WNN_LOADER_WORKERS": "0",
+            "WNN_LOADER_RAM_GB": "1.5",
+            "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1",
+            "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1",
+            "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
+            "POLARS_MAX_THREADS": "1",
+            "ARROW_NUM_THREADS": "1",
+            "PYTHONUNBUFFERED": "1",
+        }
+    )
+    recipe = json.loads((PACKET / "recipe.json").read_text())
+    split = "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+    for arm in ("feature", "control"):
+        execute(arm, "train", recipe["arms"][arm], 2400)
+    for arm in ("feature", "control"):
+        name = f"geometry_quick_f0_s3_{arm}"
+        execute(
+            arm,
+            "predict",
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-u",
+                "scripts/predict_run.py",
+                name,
+                "valid",
+                "--campaign-split-manifest",
+                split,
+                "--campaign-evaluation-only",
+                "--device",
+                "cuda",
+                "--epoch",
+                "0",
+            ],
+            600,
+        )
+        execute(
+            arm,
+            "score",
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-u",
+                "scripts/score_run.py",
+                "--run",
+                name,
+                "--split",
+                split,
+                "--epoch",
+                "0",
+            ],
+            300,
+        )
+    record("pair_complete")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# H512 local follow-up and production path
+
+## Active fit
+
+One cold H512×1 GRU fit started at 23:18:35 UTC on October 20 under
+`wnn-h512-f0-fit-r1-20261021.service`. The [admission](FIT_ADMISSION_R1.json)
+and [actual start](FIT_START_R1.json) record its source, bounds and invocation.
+This uses F0, seed 1003, six epochs and fixed checkpoint epoch 5. There are no
+new teacher fits. The proposed all-data final fit has separate admission and
+remains conditional on results and the remaining budget.
+
+The [exact recipe](H512_FIT_AND_PRODUCTION_PLAN_R1.json) adapts the PR25 wide
+arm to execution source `68ff6829`. An independent source review found no core
+flag or membership mismatch. This is an explicitly adapted implementation,
+not numerical equivalence to the B300 producer. The prior evidence consists
+of 12 width/depth pairs across four exposed folds and three seeds; the wider
+arm won 9/12. This local seed/fold was also in that prior panel.
+
+## Frozen comparison
+
+The [score screen](H512_F0_SCORE_SCREEN_R1.json) fixes seven endpoints before
+training outcomes: oldZ4, the retained WMSE continuation, H512 checkpoint 5,
+the equal parameter mean of checkpoints 3/4/5, and three fixed 75/25 blends.
+The averaged checkpoint adds no training fit and preserves identical
+normalization buffers. It is an additional interaction endpoint, not part of
+the original R01 replication. There is no coefficient or epoch search.
+
+Score the same 468 exposed F0 groups with the official metric and 2,000 paired
+component-bootstrap draws. These intervals condition on fitted models. This
+one local fit does not establish independent replication across folds or seeds.
+TL3 has unknown fitting ancestry and cannot be a clean CV comparator.
+
+## Resources and delivery
+
+The [fit log](fit_r1.log) records actual batches, loss, LR and epoch diagnostics.
+The measured short profile projects about 4.7 hours for this fit and 4.9 hours
+for all-data training; neither is a sustained-training measurement. Root owns
+exports, official grading, cumulative 15-hour accounting and native packaging.
+No quality result or new submission ZIP exists yet.
+
+The [parent resource enforcement](../h512_replication_profile/AGGREGATE_LIMIT_ENFORCEMENT_R1.json)
+now applies 5 GB aggregate task RAM, two CPU cores and zero task swap, replacing
+a stale 20 GB runtime ceiling. The worker has one CPU and a 4.2 GB RAM ceiling.
+
+## Sustained thermal limitation
+
+The [early thermal snapshot](thermal_snapshot_r1.txt) reports 89°C, active
+software thermal slowdown and SM clocks around 400 MHz. Initial cumulative
+throughput declined from 4.8 to 3.4 sequences/s by batch 60. The short-profile
+4.7-hour projection is therefore optimistic until sustained timing stabilizes.
+Root requested optional physical cooling help and will reassess final-fit
+admission from observed epoch timing. The job remains healthy; no power,
+clock or fan settings were changed.
+
+[The thermal budget amendment](THERMAL_BUDGET_AMENDMENT_R1.json) extends the healthy fold worker runtime ceiling from six to nine hours within the unchanged 15-hour allocation. Model updates and the fixed six-epoch endpoint are unchanged. At the ceiling, about 3.46 GPU-hours remain; final training and exports require separate admission against actual elapsed time. A shorter all-data continuation is a conditional alternative to the original cold six-epoch production proposal.
+
+## Prepared post-fit execution
+
+[The separate delivery plan](H512_POSTFIT_DELIVERY_PLAN_R1.json) records exact
+commands for terminal acceptance, source-manifest materialization, CPU parameter
+averaging, two FP32 exports and the frozen score. It admits no additional fit.
+
+- [Live command binding](FIT_COMMAND_BINDING_R1.json) captures the actual running
+  Python process argv, exactly equal to the frozen recipe, and all 191 resolved
+  arguments. This prevents accepting a run with optimizer or schedule drift.
+- [Terminal receipt producer](record_h512_fit_terminal.py) requires the exact
+  user-manager invocation to finish successfully, six completed epochs, fixed
+  CP5, complete argument equality, source identity and checkpoint hashes.
+- [Manifest template](SWA345_SOURCE_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_R1.json) and
+  [materializer](materialize_h512_swa_manifest.py) fill actual hashes only after
+  terminal acceptance, with create-only output.
+- [SWA derivation](derive_h512_swa345.py) and its
+  [input validator](h512_swa345_validation.py) reuse the canonical arithmetic
+  helper, require identical preprocessing and preserve cold-fold ancestry.
+  Embedded source checkpoint hashes are removed before writing derived bytes.
+
+These scripts are prepared and statically checked. They have not accepted this
+still-running fit, derived weights or produced its quality score. The optional
+production recipe is one two-epoch all-data continuation, independently admitted
+only if quality and actual remaining compute justify it. Direct packaging of a
+supported fold-trained endpoint is also eligible; another full-data fit is not
+a prerequisite for delivery.
+
+## Latest runtime and automated handoff
+
+[Runtime amendment R2](THERMAL_BUDGET_AMENDMENT_R2.json) replaces only the9hceiling with12hafter sustained throughput declined to1.9sequences/s. Previous completedGPUjob time9,158.249398seconds plus12hfit,25minpostfit and90secondsstopgrace total53,948.249398seconds, below54,000. No new fit is admitted.
+
+The [finite seven-step sequence](POSTFIT_SEQUENCE_R1.json) runs terminal acceptance, source-manifest materialization, fixedSWAderivation, twoFP32exports, [finite artifact audit](audit_h512_exports.py), and official frozen grading. The [supervisor](run_postfit_when_ready.py) waits for the exact invocation and checks source pins, new outputs, resource limits and cumulative budget. [Execution admission](POSTFIT_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_R1.json) records its conditional status; it admits no final fit or submission. The [service query check](SERVICE_QUERY_CHECK_R1.json) exercised actual user-manager properties without accepting a fit. [Grades](grades/README.md) remain absent until real execution.
+
+The separate [complete native endpoint protocol](../tl3_h512_endpoint_screen_r1/README.md) comparesCP5/SWA345replacements to originalTL3. Its unknown legacy ancestry is explicit; it is not cleanCV.
+
+[Independent static review](POSTFIT_AND_NATIVE_STATIC_REVIEW_R1.json) passed after concrete producer/path/hash corrections; a second canonicalCLI review found no remaining operational mismatch. [Actual watcher start](POSTFIT_WATCHER_START_R1.json) records the live stdlib supervisor, unit `wnn-h512-postfit-watcher-r1-20261021.service`, invocationeff981027d664a728e18b8e0e582471a. Admission is conditional on this exact fit succeeding and all pins/resource/budget/absent-output gates passing. This is a running waiter, not evidence of any completed postfit step.
+
+### First epoch completed — October21
+
+[Epoch0progress](EPOCH0_PROGRESS_R1.json) records the actual first full pass:6,549.8seconds,14,920/14,920completedupdates, zero AMPskips/nonfinitegradientsteps, mean pre-update windowobjective1.3793423, median preclip gradientnorm1.48872 andcliprate86.37%. These are training diagnostics, not a validation score. The fit continues into epoch1of zero-based0–5; the fixedCP5recipe and withheldevaluation remain unchanged.
+
+## Completed fit and page-alignment recovery, October21
+
+The six-epoch fit completed successfully at13:29:06Kyiv. [Terminal acceptance](FIT_TERMINAL_ACCEPTANCE_R1.json) verifies the original frozen recipe and actual artifacts; [SWA source manifest](SWA345_SOURCE_MANIFEST_R1.json) records the three-checkpoint derivative. No validation result yet.
+
+The original postfit launcher stopped before GPU work: Linux rounded the configured5,000,000,000byte cgroup cap down to4,999,999,488bytes. Its exact equality guard incorrectly rejected that effective limit. [Recovery amendment](POSTFIT_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_RECOVERY_R2.json) preserves the cause, original/recovery hashes and cumulative budget. The separate [recovery launcher](run_postfit_page_aligned_recovery_r2.py) checks the exact page-rounded limit and retains all original scientific pins, output guards and budget checks. The original source and failed logs remain unchanged.
+
+Recovery unit `wnn-h512-postfit-recovery-r2-20261021.service` launched the original bounded postfit sequence. At15:21Kyiv, checkpoint acceptance/SWA derivation completed and CP5 prediction export was running, using about3GBRAM without OOM. [Recovery log](postfit_recovery_r2.log) and [sequence log](postfit_r1.log) are mutable operational records, not quality evidence.
+
+## Correction: matched B300 endpoint successfully reproduced
+
+The [matched-cell audit](MATCHED_B300_SCORE_REPLICATION_R1.json) extracts the exact historical B300 PR25 wide F0/seed1003/CP5 score:0.6737706304503658. Our [full-precision local grade](grades/F0_H512_GRADE_POSTFIT_R1.json) is0.6737706291771555, a difference of−1.2732e−9. The earlier chat interpretation that the local recipe had failed to reproduce this endpoint was incorrect:0.68409111 was the historical four-fold mean, not the matching F0 score. No additional fit is needed to establish this observed score agreement.
+
+This supports endpoint-score replication of the matching wide cell, not bitwise weight/prediction parity or an independently repeated width/depth treatment effect. The existing oldZ4/WMSE blend still scores0.6835218031 on the sameF0, versus0.6822209947 for the fixed oldZ4/H512 blend. Thus successful recipe replication has not yet delivered a stronger submission endpoint. The [complete seven-step report](POSTFIT_SEQUENCE_REPORT_R1.json), [export audit](EXPORT_AUDIT_R1.json), and [postfit service terminal](POSTFIT_SERVICE_TERMINAL_R1.json) preserve successful postfit execution; [mutable postfit log](postfit_r1.log) preserves actual timing. Native package grading remains incomplete after a separate coverage-check failure.
+
+## User-authorized exploratory CP5 submission
+
+The [release receipt](EXPLORATORY_CP5_RELEASE_20261021_R1.json) records explicit latest user authority to try this candidate despite lower fixed local blend scores. [Submission folder](../../../../submissions/b300_h512_cp5_tl3_20261021/README.md) contains the17.106MBZIP plus build, ELFABI and actual Python3.11 two-sequence/A-B-A check receipts. ZIP SHAff5d5bdade2d024e0c2bf98237024cef4569664bad0fa3c99d4686e9621f54e2. This is an exploratory deterministic three-member release, not a claimed new best.
+
+The earlier full native replay reached its final coverage guard: expected file size omitted the128byteNPYheader. Its error handler deleted the cache; no full served-endpoint grade was produced. The delivered exact ZIP independently passed finite predictions/reset on40,000actual rows, with5.0576seconds callbacktime. This is not official full-runtime certification.

+"""Bind the two frozen H512 exports to accepted checkpoints and F0 membership."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "nll_adaptation"))
+from prediction_artifact_validation import GROUPS, _json, _pin, _prediction, _sha  # noqa: E402
+
+RUN = "r01_h512_f0_s1003_local_cp5_r1"
+SWA = "r01_h512_f0_s1003_local_swa345_r1"
+SPLIT_SHA = "09263ad4fe2b18e2b2f3b79f4562678dce801b067b868134ddc79279f9316a3d"
+PACKET = Path("research/campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/h512_f0_followup_r1")
+
+
+def audit(root: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Check actual output bytes before the frozen scorer accesses targets."""
+    packet = root / PACKET
+    terminal = _json(packet / "FIT_TERMINAL_ACCEPTANCE_R1.json")
+    if terminal.get("status") != "FIT_COMPLETE_ACCEPTED" or terminal.get("run_name") != RUN:
+        raise ValueError("no accepted source fit")
+    split_path = root / "research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json"
+    _pin(split_path, SPLIT_SHA)
+    split = _json(split_path)
+    plan = _json(packet / "H512_POSTFIT_DELIVERY_PLAN_R1.json")
+    records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for item in plan["prediction_exports"]["existing_baselines"]:
+        path = root / item["prediction"]
+        records.append(_pin(path, item["prediction_sha256"], 299_680_128))
+    source_provenance = root / "artifacts/runs" / RUN / "provenance.json"
+    _pin(source_provenance, terminal["provenance_sha256"])
+    expected_args = _json(source_provenance)["args"]
+    for run in (RUN, SWA):
+        directory = root / "artifacts/runs" / run
+        checkpoint = directory / "model_ep5.pt"
+        provenance_path = directory / "provenance.json"
+        provenance = _json(provenance_path)
+        checkpoint_sha = _sha(checkpoint)
+        if run == RUN:
+            expected_sha = terminal["checkpoint_sha256"]["model_ep5.pt"]
+        else:
+            derivation = _json(directory / "weight_derivation_receipt.json")
+            if (
+                derivation.get("method") != "equal_parameter_mean_epochs_3_4_5"
+                or derivation.get("source_run_name") != RUN
+                or derivation.get("destination_run_name") != SWA
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("derived endpoint is outside the frozen trajectory mean")
+            expected_sha = derivation["outputs"]["model_ep5.pt"]["sha256"]
+        if (
+            checkpoint_sha != expected_sha
+            or provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256", {}).get("model_ep5.pt") != expected_sha
+            or provenance.get("args") != expected_args
+            or provenance.get("split_manifest_sha256") != SPLIT_SHA
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint/provenance binding differs: {run}")
+        for source in ("train", "valid"):
+            groups = provenance.get("fit_row_groups", {}).get(source, [])
+            expected_groups = split["fit"][source]
+            if len(groups) != len(set(groups)) or set(groups) != set(expected_groups):
+                raise ValueError(f"fitting membership differs: {run}/{source}")
+        groups = provenance.get("evaluation_row_groups", [])
+        if len(groups) != len(set(groups)) or set(groups) != set(split["evaluation"]["valid"]):
+            raise ValueError(f"evaluation membership differs: {run}")
+        prediction = root / "cache" / f"pred_{run}_valid.npy"
+        sidecar_path = prediction.with_suffix(".json")
+        sidecar = _json(sidecar_path)
+        prediction_sha = _prediction(prediction, scan=True)
+        expected_sidecar = {
+            "run": run,
+            "split": "valid",
+            "epoch": 5,
+            "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha,
+            "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha,
+            "split_manifest_sha256": SPLIT_SHA,
+            "campaign_split_manifest_sha256": SPLIT_SHA,
+            "inference_precision": "fp32",
+            "feature_only": True,
+            "campaign_export_scope": "full-valid-feature-only",
+            "row_groups": GROUPS,
+        }
+        if any(sidecar.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_sidecar.items()):
+            raise ValueError(f"export sidecar differs: {run}")
+        records.append(
+            {
+                "run": run,
+                "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha,
+                "provenance_sha256": _sha(provenance_path),
+                "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha,
+                "sidecar_sha256": _sha(sidecar_path),
+                "all_predictions_finite": True,
+            }
+        )
+    result = {"status": "PASS", "records": records, "auditor_sha256": _sha(Path(__file__))}
+    with (packet / "EXPORT_AUDIT_R1.json").open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(result, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Audit the create-only exports before official evaluation."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(audit(args.root.resolve(strict=True)), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Create the predeclared equal epoch-3/4/5 H512 checkpoint mean."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from h512_swa345_validation import (
+    ADMISSION_PATH,
+    ADMISSION_SHA,
+    DEST_RUN,
+    HELPER_PATH,
+    HELPER_SHA,
+    ROOT_RUN,
+    TRAINING_COMMIT,
+    sha256,
+    validate_inputs,
+)
+
+
+def derive(root: Path, manifest_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Write the create-only mean checkpoint after root accepts the F0 fit."""
+    bound = validate_inputs(root, manifest_path)
+    root = bound["root"]
+    helper = bound["helper"]
+    checkpoints = bound["checkpoints"]
+    destination = root / "artifacts/runs" / DEST_RUN
+    if destination.parent != root / "artifacts/runs" or os.path.lexists(destination):
+        raise FileExistsError(f"derived output must be new: {destination}")
+    averaged = helper.mean_state([checkpoint["model"] for checkpoint in checkpoints])
+    derivation = {
+        "schema": "wnn.h512-swa345-derivation.v1",
+        "method": "equal_parameter_mean_epochs_3_4_5",
+        "source_run_name": ROOT_RUN,
+        "destination_run_name": DEST_RUN,
+        "source_checkpoints": bound["items"],
+        "input_manifest": {
+            "path": str(bound["manifest_path"].relative_to(root)),
+            "sha256": sha256(bound["manifest_path"]),
+        },
+        "fit_terminal_receipt": bound["fit_receipt"],
+        "source_provenance": bound["provenance_item"],
+        "admission_path": str(ADMISSION_PATH),
+        "admission_sha256": ADMISSION_SHA,
+        "source_training_commit": TRAINING_COMMIT,
+        "source_run_identity": bound["identity"],
+        "helper_path": str(HELPER_PATH),
+        "helper_sha256": HELPER_SHA,
+        "derivation_code_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+        "accumulation": "float64 mean followed by cast to source dtype",
+        "fixed_buffers": "mean/std and non-floating tensors must be bit-identical and are preserved",
+        "training_run": False,
+        "quality_evaluated": False,
+    }
+    derived = copy.deepcopy(checkpoints[-1])
+    derived["model"] = averaged
+    derived["weight_derivation"] = derivation
+    derived["provenance"]["weight_derivation"] = derivation
+    derived["provenance"].pop("checkpoint_sha256", None)
+    destination.mkdir()
+    output = destination / "model_ep5.pt"
+    with output.open("xb") as stream:
+        helper.torch.save(derived, stream)
+    os.link(output, destination / "model.pt")
+    output_sha = sha256(output)
+    provenance = copy.deepcopy(bound["source_provenance"])
+    provenance["weight_derivation"] = derivation
+    provenance["selected_epoch"] = 5
+    provenance["checkpoint_sha256"] = {"model_ep5.pt": output_sha, "model.pt": output_sha}
+    provenance_path = destination / "provenance.json"
+    with provenance_path.open("x") as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+    receipt = {
+        **derivation,
+        "outputs": {
+            path.name: {"sha256": sha256(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
+            for path in (output, destination / "model.pt", provenance_path)
+        },
+    }
+    with (destination / "weight_derivation_receipt.json").open("x") as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+    return receipt
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run only the fixed, no-fit/no-evaluation derivation."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("manifest", type=Path, help="post-fit input hash manifest")
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True, help="project root")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(derive(args.root, args.manifest), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Materialize the predeclared SWA manifest from accepted F0 receipts."""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+PACKET = Path("research/campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/h512_f0_followup_r1")
+TEMPLATE_SHA256 = "284c4ead1f78546f13883c054019356964fc9ae0f6e00e3b55a9eea3aec07fa7"
+RUN = "r01_h512_f0_s1003_local_cp5_r1"
+COMMIT = "68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440"
+PLAN_SHA256 = "51d797d1d568d98b0d9553c934721aab2826ba5d4d61b96a24e496ce514c7ec9"
+SCREEN_SHA256 = "f6b3b954cd2253a9eac10032c9a053f7abcd55e359c41c2062ed3bdeff2920d8"
+MAX_JSON_BYTES = 1_000_000
+
+
+def _hash_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
+
+
+def _read_object(root: Path, relative: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
+    path = (root / relative).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not path.is_relative_to(root):
+        raise ValueError(f"input escapes project root: {relative}")
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    if len(raw) > MAX_JSON_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError(f"metadata exceeds {MAX_JSON_BYTES} bytes: {path}")
+    value = json.loads(raw)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"metadata must be a JSON object: {path}")
+    return value, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+def materialize(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify terminal/provenance/checkpoint hashes and write one manifest."""
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    template, template_sha = _read_object(
+        root, str(PACKET / "SWA345_SOURCE_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE_R1.json")
+    )
+    if template_sha != TEMPLATE_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("SWA345 source template differs from its pinned bytes")
+
+    fit_item = template["fit_terminal_receipt"]
+    fit, fit_sha = _read_object(root, fit_item["path"])
+    if (
+        fit.get("schema") != "wnn.h512-fit-terminal.v1"
+        or fit.get("status") != "FIT_COMPLETE_ACCEPTED"
+        or fit.get("run_name") != RUN
+        or fit.get("source_execution_commit") != COMMIT
+        or fit.get("plan_sha256") != PLAN_SHA256
+        or fit.get("screen_sha256") != SCREEN_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("terminal receipt is not the accepted pinned F0 fit")
+
+    provenance_item = template["source_provenance"]
+    provenance, provenance_sha = _read_object(root, provenance_item["path"])
+    if (
+        fit.get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha
+        or provenance.get("args", {}).get("name") != RUN
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("source provenance differs from the accepted fit receipt")
+
+    receipt_hashes = fit.get("checkpoint_sha256", {})
+    source_hashes = provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256", {})
+    for item in template["checkpoints"]:
+        path = (root / item["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
+        if not path.is_relative_to(root):
+            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint escapes project root: {item['path']}")
+        digest = _hash_file(path)
+        name = path.name
+        if receipt_hashes.get(name) != digest or source_hashes.get(name) != digest:
+            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint bytes are not bound by both receipts: {name}")
+        item["sha256"] = digest
+
+    output = root / PACKET / "SWA345_SOURCE_MANIFEST_R1.json"
+    template["status"] = "READY_FOR_DERIVATION"
+    template["fit_terminal_receipt"]["sha256"] = fit_sha
+    template["source_provenance"]["sha256"] = provenance_sha
+    template["materialized_from_template_sha256"] = template_sha
+    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(template, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+    return {"path": str(output), "sha256": _hash_file(output), "status": template["status"]}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Create the post-fit, hash-bound derivation manifest once."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        print(json.dumps(materialize(args.root), sort_keys=True))
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+        parser.error(str(error))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def service_properties(service: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Read the completed systemd unit's result and invocation identity."""
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            "systemctl",
+            "--user",
+            "show",
+            service,
+            "--property=ActiveState",
+            "--property=SubState",
+            "--property=MainPID",
+            "--property=Result",
+            "--property=ExecMainStatus",
+            "--property=InvocationID",
+            "--property=ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic",
+            "--property=ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic",
+        ],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "=" in line)
+
+
+def record(root: Path, service: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify terminal fit evidence and create one immutable receipt."""
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)

+    start = packet / "FIT_START_R1.json"
+    log = packet / "fit_r1.log"
+    provenance_path = root / "artifacts/runs" / RUN / "provenance.json"
+    plan_path = packet / "H512_FIT_AND_PRODUCTION_PLAN_R1.json"
+    binding_path = packet / COMMAND_BINDING_PATH.name

+        (packet / "H512_F0_SCORE_SCREEN_R1.json", SCREEN_SHA),
+        (binding_path, COMMAND_BINDING_SHA),

+    binding = read_json(binding_path)
+    started = read_json(start)
+    properties = service_properties(service)
+    invocation = started.get("service", {}).get("InvocationID")
+    binding_service = binding.get("service", {})
+    binding_invocation = binding_service.get("InvocationID")
+    if (
+        binding.get("schema") != "wnn.live-fit-command-binding.v1"
+        or binding.get("unit") != service
+        or binding.get("frozen_plan_sha256") != PLAN_SHA
+        or binding.get("actual_training_argv") != plan.get("f0_fit", {}).get("argv")
+        or started.get("service", {}).get("InvocationID") != binding_invocation
+        or properties.get("InvocationID") != binding_invocation
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("live command binding differs from the frozen F0 recipe or service")
+    active = properties.get("ActiveState")
+    substate = properties.get("SubState")
+    settled = (active == "active" and substate == "exited") or (
+        active == "inactive" and substate in {"dead", "inactive"}
+    )
+    try:
+        start_monotonic = int(properties["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"])
+        exit_monotonic = int(properties["ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic"])
+    except (KeyError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("systemd did not report monotonic start/exit timestamps") from error
+    if (
+        not settled
+        or properties.get("MainPID") != "0"
+        or properties.get("Result") != "success"
+        or properties.get("ExecMainStatus") != "0"
+        or properties.get("InvocationID") != invocation
+        or exit_monotonic <= start_monotonic
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("service is running, incomplete, failed, or has a different invocation")
+

+# Conditional local H512 cost profile
+
+Status: **NOT_ADMITTED**. The [profile plan](PROFILE_PLAN_R1.json) derives the
+wide-arm command from the frozen PR25/R01 recipe and rebinds it to the existing
+local producer, canonical F0 manifest and seed1003. It preserves the cold
+211-input H512×1, label-only, strictFP32, B8/C2000, six-epoch schedule with
+fixedCP5, AdamW1e-4, OneCycle, deterministic seeded batches, no pinning/fast
+loader flag, no auxiliary terms and no fit-time validation. The finite profile
+is one warm-up plus three measured batches (40chunk updates), not a scientific
+six-epoch fit or quality result.
+
+The [independent PR results review](../../../unified/reviews/B300_PR_RUN_UPDATE_REVIEW_20261019_R1.md)
+records12available exposed-fold width/depth pairs. Wide wins9/12 and averages
+0.68409111 versus0.68331379 for deep. This favors a conditional wide-model
+replication if NLL has little endpoint value; it does not guarantee a local
+win. Actual PR25 quality seeds are1003–1005. The original seed1001 command was
+a profile/staged recipe, so changing seed/source/paths is explicitly derived.
+
+A metadata-only independent review rejected the assumed4h+4h fold/production
+cost. The short B300 profile extrapolates to about5.8h and6.1h, before setup
+and delivery, and is not local timing. This local profile must determine
+whether a complete endpoint fits the remaining15-hour budget. It admits zero
+new fits and may only run after the current single-GPU chain drains.
+
+The new execution source68ff6829 differs from R01's a266b036; source equivalence
+is not claimed. The plan pins original recipe/command bytes and names both
+revisions. Before any profile, verify source/data/split identity, defaults,
+resource headroom and the shared GPU lock. A later H512 fit needs its own exact
+recipe, cost reservation and frozen official comparison. Replacing TL3's plain
+student with H512 could preserve three models, but ZIP size, CPU runtime and
+blend contribution are unmeasured.
+
+## Actual local profile completed
+
+[Admission](PROFILE_ADMISSION_R1.json), [raw log](profile_r1.log), and [result](PROFILE_RESULT_R1.json) bind the derived source and actual data checks. Service4efb14e7231e4252ad407af755c6c3cd completed successfully in15.17seconds:40/40finite optimizer updates, no AMP, zero process swaps, cgroup peak3.602GB. +# Post-Fit Package and Replay Commands
+
+Preparation only. None of these commands has been run from this manifest. They
+do not assert checkpoint availability, model quality, or measured serving speed.
+Use the existing physical scratch disk for all outputs. Do not stage outputs in
+`/tmp` or `/dev/shm`.
+
+## Common paths and resource wrapper
+
+Run from the integrated repository after the active fit releases its resources:
+
+```bash
+ROOT=/home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack
+SCRATCH=/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp
+NATIVE_BUILT=$SCRATCH/overnight-ema-native-20261020-artifacts/native-built
+RUNS=$ROOT/artifacts/runs
+OUT=$SCRATCH/overnight-ema-candidate-packages-20261020
+CHECKS=$OUT/checks
+mkdir -p "$OUT" "$CHECKS"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+limited() {
+  WNN_MEM_MAX=2000000000 WNN_CPU_QUOTA=100% WNN_THREADS=1 \
+    WNN_TMP_ROOT="$SCRATCH" "$ROOT/scripts/limited" "$@"
+}
+```
+
+Every build, Python export, ABI check, replay, and Docker gate below runs through
+`limited`: one CPU, 2,000,000,000 bytes of memory, zero swap, one numerical
+thread, and physical-disk scratch. The Python 3.11 container repeats the 2 GB
+cap with `--memory=2g --memory-swap=2g`.
+
+## Add the required AVX2 member
+
+The frozen native source tree used for v2/v3 is
+`32a1ddd91af86913cda40e113029d7bb283b806f`. Check that
+`git rev-parse HEAD:native` still returns this tree. Build AVX2 as the first
+post-fit native preparation step:
+
+```bash
+limited /usr/bin/time -v env \
+  WNN_BUILD_CPUS=1 WNN_BUILD_MEM=2000000000 \
+  WNN_USE_EXISTING_BUILD_IMAGE=1 WNN_BUILD_LEVELS=avx2 \
+  "$ROOT/scripts/build_native.sh" "$NATIVE_BUILT"
+```
+
+This creates `native-built/avx2/wnn_native.abi3.so` and reruns the static ABI
+gate over v2/avx2/v3. The packager requires all three directories. The current
+`solution_multi.py` dispatch uses v2 or v3; do not copy another binary under an
+incorrect AVX2 label.
+
+## Export only the selected candidate
+
+The two candidate checkpoints are
+`overnight_nll_f0_s3_nll_e2_r1@ep1` and
+`overnight_nll_f0_s3_wmse_e2_r1@ep1`. The optional fixed blend is
+`oldz4_h230_student_f0_s3_r3@ep1:0.75` with
+`overnight_nll_f0_s3_nll_e2_r1@ep1:0.25`. Select the model and precision from
+the fit evidence first; the commands below package only the explicitly chosen
+endpoint. There is no six-package candidate/precision loop.
+
+For an ordinary 211-input H256×2 member, the exporter should record
+`input_width: 211` and `representation_mode: none`. The optional blend has the
+same 211-input representation. The exporter loads the checkpoint on CPU,
+requires provenance, retains the first two output rows, and rejects unsupported
+feature modes. Confirm that the exact selected run directory, checkpoint, and
+provenance sidecar exist before export. `solution_multi.py` reads package
+precision metadata and supports `q16x` and `q8vnni`.
+
+Set `NAME`, `PRECISION`, and `RUN_REFS` to one quality-selected endpoint, then
+run this once for that endpoint:
+
+```bash
+NAME=nll-h256-e2-q16x
+PRECISION=q16x
+RUN_REFS=('overnight_nll_f0_s3_nll_e2_r1@ep1:1.0')
+limited env PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src" "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" \
+  "$ROOT/scripts/package_submission.py" "$NAME" "${RUN_REFS[@]}" \
+  --runs-dir "$RUNS" --native-from "$NATIVE_BUILT" \
+  --solution "$ROOT/submission/solution_multi.py" \
+  --precision "$PRECISION" --require-provenance --normalized-coefficients \
+  --output-zip "$OUT/$NAME.zip" --receipt "$OUT/$NAME.build.json" \
+  --evidence-note "Fixed checkpoint export; packaging is not a quality or speed claim."
+```
+
+For the WMSE member, set `RUN_REFS=('overnight_nll_f0_s3_wmse_e2_r1@ep1:1.0')`.
+For the optional blend, set
+`RUN_REFS=('oldz4_h230_student_f0_s3_r3@ep1:0.75' 'overnight_nll_f0_s3_nll_e2_r1@ep1:0.25')`.
+Use a distinct `NAME` and `PRECISION` only when evidence calls for another
+package. The packager is create-only, checks the 20,000,000-byte ZIP limit, and
+records checkpoint, tensor, native-library, and ZIP hashes.
+
+## Static ABI and Python 3.11 callback gate
+
+After the AVX2 build and selected package, inspect their actual bytes:
+
+```bash
+limited "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/scripts/check_submission_abi.py" "$NATIVE_BUILT"
+limited "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/scripts/check_submission_abi.py" "$OUT/$NAME.zip"
+```
+
+These checks inspect ELF/ABI metadata; they do not run the callback. For the
+Python 3.11 callback gate, use the already-present
+`$ROOT/cache/valid_subset20.parquet`; do not make another data copy. For each
+native level v2 and v3, save a bounded reference replay from the actual ZIP and
+compare it in the offline Python 3.11 image:
+
+```bash
+PARITY_DATA=$ROOT/cache/valid_subset20.parquet
+ZIP=$OUT/$NAME.zip
+for LEVEL in v2 v3; do
+  REFERENCE=$CHECKS/$NAME.$LEVEL.reference.npz
+  limited env WNN_NATIVE_LEVEL="$LEVEL" PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src" \
+    "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/scripts/verify_submission.py" \
+    "$ZIP" "$PARITY_DATA" "$REFERENCE"
+  limited docker run --rm --network none --cpus=1 --memory=2g --memory-swap=2g \
+    --pids-limit=128 \
+    -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=void \
+    -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 -e OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 -e MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 \
+    -e PYTHONPATH= -e LD_LIBRARY_PATH= -e TMPDIR=/checks \
+    -v "$ROOT:/workspace:ro" -v "$OUT:/artifacts:ro" \
+    -v "$CHECKS:/checks:rw" -w /workspace \
+    wnn-python311-submission-check:latest \
+    python scripts/check_submission_python311.py \
+      --zip "/artifacts/$NAME.zip" \
+      --data /workspace/cache/valid_subset20.parquet \
+      --level "$LEVEL" \
+      --reference "/checks/$NAME.$LEVEL.reference.npz" \
+      --output "/checks/$NAME.$LEVEL.python311.json"
+done
+```
+
+Use fresh `NAME`/output paths; both verifier artifacts and callback receipts are
+create-only. The offline gate requires Python 3.11, clean library/Python paths,
+two full sequences, finite `(2,)` float32 callback values, agreement within
+`1e-6` with the reference, a reset-prefix replay, and the requested native level.
+This is packaging/runtime compatibility evidence, not a quality comparison.
+
+Do not use `scripts/benchmark_submission_callbacks.py` here: it expects
+`model.model` and the legacy receipt schema and only covers q8, so it does not
+match `solution_multi.py` packages. `verify_submission.py` calls the actual
+submission callback and provides the needed row-time measurement.
+
+## One source-qualified official-metric replay
+
+Use the fit's frozen manifest at
+`research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json`. The verifier calls
+`load_campaign_split(SPLIT, ROOT)`, checks all manifest sources, requires the exact
+`datasets/valid.parquet`, validates each selected row group's `seq_ix`, and
+replays `evaluation_groups` in manifest order. Predictions, targets, and mask
+are streamed through bounded temporary memmaps. The receipt contains the
+ordered row groups, source path, split SHA-256, sequence IDs, rounded log fields,
+and the full unrounded `GlobalAccumulator.result()` value. This fold is
+evaluation exposure for its fitted models; it is not a fresh holdout.
+
+After one fixed candidate and native level are selected, run this once for that
+served endpoint:
+
+```bash
+SPLIT=$ROOT/research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold0.json
+LEVEL=v3
+limited env WNN_NATIVE_LEVEL="$LEVEL" PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src" \
+  "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/scripts/verify_submission.py" \
+  "$OUT/$NAME.zip" "$ROOT/datasets/valid.parquet" \
+  "$OUT/$NAME.$LEVEL.fold0.npz" \
+  --campaign-split-manifest "$SPLIT" \
+  --receipt "$OUT/$NAME.$LEVEL.fold0.json"
+```
+
+This is the callback replay and official accumulator for the exact selected
+source-qualified fold. Do not repeat it with the full `valid.parquet` or run
+`scripts/native_validation_score.py` on the same ZIP as a duplicate scorer.
+The subset20 Python 3.11 gate above is separate packaging compatibility only.
+The verifier writes through memmaps; for 468 groups the prediction, target, and
+mask payload is approximately 159 MB before NPZ framing. Keep it on physical
+scratch. The earlier estimate of 669 MB applies to every validation row group,
+which this selected-fold replay does not read.
+
+## Analytic payload and runtime costs
+
+Assuming standard `RNNModel`, linear 211-to-H encoder, two GRU layers,
+`encoder_width = recurrent_width = readout_width = H`, one hidden readout layer,
+and an exported final head truncated to two targets:
+
+| Export | Float32 values, including `mean`/`std` | Raw tensor bytes |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| H256×2, 211 inputs | 976,040 | 3,904,160 B (3.72 MiB) |
+| H230×2, 211 inputs | 793,234 | 3,172,936 B (3.03 MiB) |
+| H230 + H256 blend | 1,769,274 | 7,077,096 B (6.75 MiB) |
+
+The built v2/v3 libraries add 2,413,408 bytes; the required AVX2 library adds
+about another 1.2 MB at the current build scale. Exact ZIP size is known after
+export. Check checkpoint arguments and `members.json` before relying on these
+counts. Loading `.pt` checkpoints uses Torch and can require substantially more
+temporary memory than the exported model. Approximate dense MACs per row are
+972,032 for H256×2 and 789,590 for H230×2. The H230/H256 blend performs about
+1,761,622 MACs per row (1.81× H256 alone); its 75%/25% weights do not skip either
+predictor. q16x/q8vnni speed and quality remain measured questions.

+
+This receipt records the native EMA serving preparation for the FG19 467-input
+GRU path. The implementation is integrated on main as `7a46eedd4`; this
+worktree holds the bounded v2/v3 builds and the remaining small delivery
+changes.
+The serving path supports the control suffix and causal EMA suffix, preserves
+the existing 211- and 323-input modes, and fails closed on unsupported sparse
+representations. The producer source was frozen at
+`68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440`.
+
+## Evidence and status
+
+- `receipt.json` records source and artifact hashes, ABI details, build command,
+  resource measurements, the synthetic producer EMA comparison, and outstanding
+  checks.
+- `COMMAND_MANIFEST.md` maps the post-fit AVX2 build, fixed-member package
+  exports, static ABI check, Python 3.11 callback gate, and local official
+  metric replay. Its commands are prepared only and have not been run.
+- The bounded v2 and v3 builds passed `scripts/check_submission_abi.py`. Both
+  used the same native source tree (`32a1ddd91af86913cda40e113029d7bb283b806f`)
+  and Cargo lockfile. The v2 extension is outside the repository at
+  `/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/overnight-ema-native-20261020-artifacts/native-built/v2/wnn_native.abi3.so`.
+- The v2 extension is 1,181,912 bytes, SHA256
+  `253e674ccb50ab633afc72d77744c138699fa68b1b2e5ae8d82a2121d5e29511`.
+- The v3 extension is 1,231,496 bytes, SHA256
+  `11b4c437fc394253366e650c0021ace3ad3caa77761bbf759ae6f6e194b98577`; it is
+  at `/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/overnight-ema-native-20261020-artifacts/native-built/v3/wnn_native.abi3.so`.
+- Both use the `cp311-abi3-manylinux_2_34_x86_64` wheel tag, require at most
+  GLIBC 2.34, and have no `libpython` dependency. The v3-only bounded build took
+  37.43 seconds; sampled container memory was 222.3 MiB / 1.863 GiB with no
+  swap. The sample is not an absolute peak measurement.
+- The synthetic EMA comparison used three independent sequences, 1,025 rows,
+  112 features, and seed 20261020. The float32 online recurrence starts at
+  zero for each sequence and agreed with the frozen producer helper to max
+  absolute error `3.54e-8` (mean absolute error `5.86e-9`). This checks the
+  mathematical recurrence; it is not a loaded-extension callback or checkpoint
+  parity claim.
+- `solution_multi.py` now reads the package's existing `precision.txt` and
+  passes its value to `Predictor`; old packages without that file use `f32`.
+  This restores the already-supported `q16x` and `q8vnni` package choices along
+  with `f32`, `f16`, and `i16`. Package build defaults are unchanged, including
+  the legacy v2/avx2/v3 set.
+- The first bounded Docker attempt was stopped after about 26 seconds because I
+  initially misread the dependency-install restriction. It was downloading
+  Cargo.lock-pinned crates, which the parent then explicitly authorized. The
+  transient container was removed, its partial target scratch was cleaned, and
+  no Python environment was changed. The successful v2 build used the pinned
+  lockfile.
+
+## Remaining release checks
+
+The v2 shared library still needs an import and scorer-callback check in the
+packaging runtime, including reset behavior across independent sequences. A
+real checkpoint is not available in the staged source area, so its appended
+normalizer values, exported metadata, and predictions remain unverified. In
+particular, verify that the exported 467-wide checkpoint has the expected
+shared normalizers (appended mean 0 and standard deviation 1) before packaging.
+No FG19 score, checkpoint parity, or serving latency is claimed here. The
+parent authorized v3 after the two short local GPU profiles completed; no
+additional build is pending.
+
+The JSON receipt is the compact reproducibility record. The parent owns the
+campaign index and will add the navigation link.

+# Matched GRU continuation: actual F0 results
+
+## Question and method
+
+Does Gaussian NLL improve a strong GRU continuation or its contribution to a stronger saved model? Two new H256×2 fits, one per objective, share initialization, sampling/normalization identities, teacher targets and the two-epoch schedule. No new teacher fits. Strict FP32 updates start from historical mixed-precision ancestry; this is not a fresh-FP32 replication. Fixed zero-based epoch1 and seven endpoints were frozen before outcomes.
+
+## Measured endpoints
+
+Official `global_wp_clip2_v1`, 468 exposed valid-source groups /141 connected components.
+
+| Endpoint | WP |

+| parent_cp5 | 0.6811553603 |

+| oldz4_075_nll_025_minus_oldz4_075_wmse_025 | -0.0000038521 | [-0.0001418886, +0.0001146902] |
+
+## Interpretation and limitations
+
+NLL does not show an advantage over matched WMSE here. The two fixed oldZ4 blends have almost identical point scores and modest positive contributions. Intervals condition on these fitted models and resample141 evaluation components; they do not measure fitting-seed variation or public transfer. No interval crossing zero closes the broader family. F0 is exposed, one seed was fitted, and this does not establish an improvement over TL3.
+
+NLL clipped100% of updates, versus roughly7% for WMSE; readout gradients dominate the NLL squared-gradient diagnostic. This suggests a possible objective/optimization interaction, without identifying individual head rows or proving AdamW parameter-step suppression.
+
+Independent review resolved the apparent parent discrepancy: historical0.6828233414 belongs to a different oldZ4 parent checkpoint, not this T3 CP5. Historical oldZ4 student0.6831418134 and current0.6831643304 share checkpoint/fold/target/mask identities but use FP16 and FP32 exports respectively; historical scorer-code hashes are unavailable, so precision-only attribution is not proven. Actual independent source/metric/ancestry review passes. No paired interval was frozen for oldZ4 versus T3CP5; only the seven declared contrasts have intervals.
+
+## Decision and next step
+
+Preserve both children and all seven endpoints. Defer the prepared F1 NLL pair for opportunity cost, rather than reject heteroscedastic modeling. Prioritize the PR25-supported cold H512 width route after an actual local cost profile. Require complete endpoint evaluation and native package checks before recommending a ZIP.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Scoped adaptation of the existing research file-cache guard; never reclaims swap.
+set -u
+group=/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/wnn.slice/wnn-campaign.slice
+worker=wnn-overnight-nll-fit-20261020.service
+while [[ $(systemctl --user show "$worker" -p MainPID --value) != 0 ]]; do
+  current=$(cat "$group/memory.current")
+  if (( current > 4400000000 )); then
+    available=$(awk '$1=="inactive_file" {print $2}' "$group/memory.stat")
+    requested=$((current - 4000000000))
+    (( requested > available )) && requested=$available
+    if (( requested > 0 )); then
+      printf '%s swappiness=0\n' "$requested" > "$group/memory.reclaim" 2>/dev/null || true
+      printf '%s before=%s requested=%s after=%s\n' \
+        "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$current" "$requested" "$(cat "$group/memory.current")"
+    fi
+  fi
+  sleep 5
+done

+"""Fail-closed preflight and post-export audit for the frozen F0 score plan.
+
+Preflight pins sources, inputs, reused caches, and absent outputs. Post-export
+binds checkpoints, provenance, sidecars, and finite float32 predictions into a
+create-only receipt. This CLI imports NumPy and the standard library only.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+SHAPE = (1873, 20_000, 2)
+NBYTES = 299_680_128
+GROUPS = list(range(1873))
+
+
+def _json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a JSON object."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file with bounded memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _pin(path: Path, digest: str, size: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check and return a pinned file identity."""
+    actual_size, actual_sha = path.stat().st_size, _sha(path)
+    if actual_sha != digest or (size is not None and actual_size != size):
+        raise ValueError(f"file identity mismatch: {path}")
+    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": actual_size, "sha256": actual_sha}
+
+
+def _prediction(path: Path, scan: bool = False) -> str | None:
+    """Check NPY geometry and optionally hash finite values row by row."""
+    if path.stat().st_size != NBYTES:
+        raise ValueError(f"prediction size mismatch: {path}")
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        version = np.lib.format.read_magic(stream)
+        reader = {
+            (1, 0): np.lib.format.read_array_header_1_0,
+            (2, 0): np.lib.format.read_array_header_2_0,
+        }.get(version)
+        if reader is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported NPY version {version}: {path}")
+        shape, fortran, dtype = reader(stream)
+        offset = stream.tell()
+        if tuple(shape) != SHAPE or fortran or dtype != np.dtype(np.float32):
+            raise ValueError(f"prediction shape/order/dtype mismatch: {path}")
+        if not scan:
+            return None
+        stream.seek(0)
+        header = stream.read(offset)
+        if len(header) != offset:
+            raise ValueError(f"truncated NPY header: {path}")
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(header)
+        row_bytes = SHAPE[1] * SHAPE[2] * 4
+        for row in range(SHAPE[0]):
+            block = stream.read(row_bytes)
+            values = np.frombuffer(block, dtype=dtype)
+            if len(block) != row_bytes or values.size != SHAPE[1] * SHAPE[2]:
+                raise ValueError(f"truncated prediction row {row}: {path}")
+            if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+                raise ValueError(f"non-finite predictions at row {row}: {path}")
+            digest.update(block)
+        if stream.read(1):
+            raise ValueError(f"trailing prediction bytes: {path}")
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _footer(path: Path) -> tuple[int, str]:
+    """Hash a Parquet footer and trailer without reading data pages."""
+    size = path.stat().st_size
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        if size < 8:
+            raise ValueError(f"Parquet file is too short: {path}")
+        stream.seek(-8, 2)
+        trailer = stream.read(8)
+        length = int.from_bytes(trailer[:4], "little")
+        if trailer[4:] != b"PAR1" or length > size - 8:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid Parquet footer: {path}")
+        stream.seek(-8 - length, 2)
+        digest, left = hashlib.sha256(), length + 8
+        while left:
+            block = stream.read(min(left, 1 << 20))
+            if not block:
+                raise ValueError(f"truncated Parquet footer: {path}")
+            digest.update(block)
+            left -= len(block)
+    return length, digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _sources(plan: dict[str, Any], eval_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Check pinned predictor, scorer, imports, and frozen manifests."""
+    pins, checked = plan["source_pins"], []
+    root, predictor, scorer = (
+        Path(plan["source_pins"]["project_root"]),
+        pins["predictor"],
+        pins["screen_scorer"],
+    )
+    worktree = Path(predictor["path"]).parents[1]
+    files = [(Path(predictor["path"]), predictor["sha256"])]
+    files += [(worktree / name, digest) for name, digest in predictor["imports_sha256"].items()]
+    files += [
+        (Path(scorer["path"]), scorer["sha256"]),
+        (Path(scorer["frozen_component"]["path"]), scorer["frozen_component"]["sha256"]),
+    ]
+    files += [(root / name, digest) for name, digest in scorer["imports_sha256"].items()]
+    checked.extend(_pin(path, digest) for path, digest in files)
+    for key, path in (
+        ("split_manifest", Path(pins["split_manifest"]["path"])),
+        ("frozen_evaluation_manifest", eval_path),
+        ("screen_definition", Path(pins["screen_definition"]["path"])),
+    ):
+        pin = pins[key]
+        if path.resolve() != Path(pin["path"]).resolve():
+            raise ValueError(f"frozen {key} path mismatch")
+        checked.append(_pin(path, pin["sha256"]))
+    return checked
+
+
+def _fold(
+    path: Path, digest: str, evaluation: dict[str, Any]
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[int, int]]]:
+    """Check F0 source-qualified evaluation and component-safe fit groups."""
+    if _sha(path) != digest:
+        raise ValueError("fold0 manifest hash mismatch")
+    split, rows = _json(path), _json(path)["sequences"]
+    if split.get("fold") != 0:
+        raise ValueError("score plan requires fold 0")
+    components = {
+        s: {int(r["row_group"]): int(r["component"]) for r in rows[s]} for s in ("train", "valid")
+    }
+    scored = evaluation["evaluation_groups"]
+    by_row = {
+        int(r["row_group"]): int(r["component"]) for r in scored if r.get("source") == "valid"
+    }
+    expected = set(map(int, split["evaluation"]["valid"]))
+    if len(scored) != 468 or len(by_row) != len(scored) or set(by_row) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("evaluation manifest must match the 468 valid-source fold rows")
+    if any(components["valid"].get(g) != c for g, c in by_row.items()):
+        raise ValueError("evaluation component IDs differ from fold0.json")
+    eval_components = set(by_row.values())
+    for source in ("train", "valid"):
+        fitted = set(map(int, split["fit"][source]))
+        if (source == "valid" and fitted.intersection(by_row)) or eval_components.intersection(
+            components[source][g] for g in fitted
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("fold fitting membership overlaps scored components")
+    return split, components
+
+
+def _targets(root: Path, evaluation: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check target-cache bytes and row index without loading targets or masks."""
+    pin = evaluation["data_pins"]["valid_targets"]
+    path = root / pin["path"]
+    identity = _pin(path, pin["file_sha256_from_prior_frozen_grade"], pin["bytes"])
+    with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as archive:
+        groups, seqs = (
+            np.asarray(archive["row_group"], dtype=np.int64),
+            np.asarray(archive["seq_ix"], dtype=np.int64),
+        )
+    if groups.tolist() != GROUPS or groups.shape != seqs.shape:
+        raise ValueError("valid_targets row order changed")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for values in (groups, seqs):
+        digest.update(np.asarray(values, dtype="<i8").tobytes())
+    if digest.hexdigest() != pin["index_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("valid_targets index digest changed")
+    return {**identity, "index_sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "row_groups": [0, 1872, len(groups)]}
+
+
+def _cache(item: dict[str, Any], split_sha: str, checkpoint_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check a reused prediction cache, its sidecar, and its checkpoint pin."""
+    path, side_path = (
+        Path(item["prediction_path"]),
+        Path(item["prediction_path"]).with_suffix(".json"),
+    )
+    prediction = _pin(path, item["prediction_sha256"], item["prediction_bytes"])
+    side_identity = _pin(side_path, item["sidecar_sha256"])
+    side = _json(side_path)
+    if (
+        side.get("run") != item["run"]
+        or side.get("split") != "valid"
+        or side.get("epoch") != item["epoch"]
+        or side.get("prediction_sha256") != item["prediction_sha256"]
+        or side.get("checkpoint_sha256") != checkpoint_sha
+        or side.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha
+        or side.get("inference_precision") != item["inference_precision"]
+        or side.get("row_groups") != GROUPS
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"reused cache sidecar mismatch: {side_path}")
+    if item.get("id") == "parent_cp5" and side.get("campaign_split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha:
+        raise ValueError("parent cache campaign split hash mismatch")
+    _prediction(path)
+    return {"prediction": prediction, "sidecar": side_identity}
+
+
+def _base(
+    plan_path: Path, eval_path: Path, verification: dict[str, Any]
+) -> tuple[
+    dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[int, int]], dict[str, Any]
+]:
+    """Verify all pinned code/data inputs and reused cache identities."""
+    plan, evaluation = _json(plan_path), _json(eval_path)
+    sources = _sources(plan, eval_path)
+    pins, root = plan["source_pins"], Path(plan["source_pins"]["project_root"])
+    split_pin = pins["split_manifest"]
+    split_path = Path(split_pin["path"])
+    split, components = _fold(split_path, split_pin["sha256"], evaluation)
+    valid_input = next(
+        row
+        for row in verification["inputs"]
+        if Path(row["path"]) == root / "datasets/valid.parquet"
+    )
+    parquet = evaluation["data_pins"]["valid_parquet"]
+    parquet_path = root / parquet["path"]
+    stat = parquet_path.stat()
+    if (
+        stat.st_size != parquet["bytes"]
+        or stat.st_size != valid_input["bytes"]
+        or stat.st_mtime_ns != valid_input["mtime_ns"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("valid.parquet size or frozen mtime changed")
+    footer_bytes, footer_sha = _footer(parquet_path)
+    if footer_sha != parquet["footer_sha256"] or footer_sha != valid_input["footer_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("valid.parquet footer hash changed")
+    parent = next(x for x in plan["endpoints"] if x["id"] == "parent_cp5")
+    old = next(x for x in plan["endpoints"] if x["id"] == "oldz4_cp1_fp32")
+    ref = dict(plan["historical_reference_artifacts"][0])
+    ref["checkpoint_sha256"] = old["checkpoint_sha256"]
+    caches = {
+        "parent_cp5": _cache(parent, split_pin["sha256"], parent["checkpoint_sha256"]),
+        "oldz4_historical_fp16": _cache(ref, split_pin["sha256"], old["checkpoint_sha256"]),
+    }
+    root_ids = []
+    for item in (parent, old):
+        run_root = root / "artifacts" / "runs" / item["run"]
+        checkpoint = run_root / f"model_ep{item['epoch']}.pt"
+        root_ids.append(_pin(checkpoint, item["checkpoint_sha256"]))
+    base = {
+        "source_identities": sources,
+        "split_manifest": {"path": str(split_path), "sha256": split_pin["sha256"], "fold": 0},
+        "inputs": {
+            "valid_parquet": {
+                "path": str(parquet_path),
+                "bytes": parquet["bytes"],
+                "mtime_ns": stat.st_mtime_ns,
+                "footer_bytes": footer_bytes,
+                "footer_sha256": footer_sha,
+            },
+            "valid_targets": _targets(root, evaluation),
+        },
+        "prediction_contract": {
+            "shape": list(SHAPE),
+            "dtype": "float32",
+            "bytes": NBYTES,
+            "row_groups": [0, 1872, len(GROUPS)],
+        },
+        "reused_caches": caches,
+        "checkpoint_identities": root_ids,
+    }
+    return plan, evaluation, split, components, base
+
+
+def _absent(plan: dict[str, Any], receipt: Path, post_receipt: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Require new prediction, temporary, sidecar, seqsum, and receipt paths absent."""
+    root, paths = Path(plan["source_pins"]["project_root"]), [receipt, post_receipt]
+    paths.append(Path(plan["screen"]["report_path"]))
+    for item in plan["endpoints"]:
+        if item.get("argv"):
+            final, stem = Path(item["prediction_path"]), item["output_name"]
+            paths += [
+                final,
+                final.with_name(final.name + ".partial"),
+                final.with_suffix(".json"),
+                root / "cache" / f"seqsums_{stem}.npz",
+            ]
+    present = [str(path) for path in paths if path.exists()]
+    if present:
+        raise FileExistsError("new output paths must be absent: " + ", ".join(present))
+    return [str(path) for path in paths]

+
+_BOOLEAN_OPTIONS = {

+def _fit_args_by_name(recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Parse each frozen fit argv into the exact provenance arguments expected."""
+    result = {}
+    for arm in recipe["design"]["arms"]:
+        argv = arm["fit_argv"]
+        if not isinstance(argv, list) or len(argv) < 2:
+            raise ValueError("recipe arm has no executable fit argv")
+        expected: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        cursor = 1
+        while cursor < len(argv):
+            option = argv[cursor]
+            if not isinstance(option, str) or not option.startswith("--"):
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid fit option in recipe: {option!r}")
+            key = option[2:].replace("-", "_")
+            if key in expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"duplicate fit option in recipe: {option}")
+            if option in _BOOLEAN_OPTIONS:
+                expected[key] = True
+                cursor += 1
+                continue
+            if cursor + 1 >= len(argv) or str(argv[cursor + 1]).startswith("--"):
+                raise ValueError(f"fit option has no value in recipe: {option}")
+            expected[key] = argv[cursor + 1]
+            cursor += 2
+        name = expected.get("name")
+        if not isinstance(name, str) or name in result:
+            raise ValueError("recipe fit names must be unique strings")
+        if expected.get("mean_variance_objective") != arm["objective"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} objective differs from its recipe arm")
+        result[name] = expected
+    return result

+def _args_match(actual: Any, expected: Any) -> bool:
+    """Compare string argv values with typed provenance values."""
+    if isinstance(actual, bool):
+        return expected is True and actual is True
+    if isinstance(actual, int):
+        try:
+            return actual == int(expected)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return False
+    if isinstance(actual, float):
+        try:
+            return actual == float(expected)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return False
+    return actual == expected
+

+while [[ $(systemctl --user show "$fit" -p MainPID --value) != 0 ]]; do

+  sleep 15

+[[ ! -e "$packet/STOP_POST_FIT" ]] || exit 0

+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+packet = Path(sys.argv[1])
+report = json.loads((packet / "fit_plan_report.json").read_text())
+expected = ["wmse_two_epoch_fit", "nll_two_epoch_fit"]
+if report["status"] != "complete" or [s["name"] for s in report["steps"]] != expected:
+    raise RuntimeError("The admitted pair did not complete in its frozen order")
+if any(s["returncode"] != 0 for s in report["steps"]):
+    raise RuntimeError("A fit failed; no prediction exports admitted")
+admission = json.loads((packet / "post_fit_admission.json").read_text())
+for name, expected_hash in admission["execution_pins"].items():
+    if hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected_hash:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Post-fit source or plan changed: {name}")
+source = admission["producer_worktree"]
+subprocess.run(
+    ["git", "-C", source, "diff", "--exit-code", admission["producer_revision"],
+     "--", "src/wnn", "scripts", "utils.py"], check=True,
+)
+extra = subprocess.check_output(

+     "src/wnn", "scripts", "utils.py"], text=True,

+if any(name.endswith(".py") for name in extra):
+    raise RuntimeError("Untracked Python source in the frozen producer execution tree")
+properties = subprocess.check_output(
+    ["systemctl", "--user", "show", admission["fit_unit"], "-p",
+     "ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic", "-p", "ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic"], text=True,
+)
+times = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in properties.splitlines())
+fit_seconds = (int(times["ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic"])
+               - int(times["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"])) / 1e6
+spent = admission["prior_profile_seconds"] + fit_seconds

+    raise RuntimeError("Post-fit work does not fit the remaining 15-hour allocation")
+with (packet / "post_fit_start.json").open("x") as stream:

+PY
+

+  printf '%s swappiness=0\n' "$available" > "$group/memory.reclaim" 2>/dev/null || true
+fi
+
+systemd-run --user --unit="$export_unit" --slice=wnn-campaign.slice \

+  -p CPUQuota=100% -p MemoryHigh=3400000000 -p MemoryMax=4000000000 \
+  -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p RuntimeMaxSec=2700 -p TimeoutStopSec=60 \
+  -p RemainAfterExit=yes -p Nice=10 -p IOSchedulingClass=idle \

+  --setenv "PYTHONPATH=$source_root/src" --setenv "TMPDIR=$source_root" \

+  --setenv WNN_LOADER_RAM_GB=3.5 \
+  --setenv WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES=4500000000 \
+  --setenv OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 --setenv MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 --setenv OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 \
+  /usr/bin/flock --nonblock \
+  "$root/research/campaign_2026-10-06/bandit_continuation/runtime/gpu.lock" \
+  /usr/bin/time -v "$root/.venv/bin/python" "$root/scripts/kaggle_sequence.py" \
+  --plan "$packet/post_fit_plan.json"
+
+while [[ $(systemctl --user show "$export_unit" -p MainPID --value) != 0 ]]; do
+  current=$(cat "$group/memory.current")
+  if (( current > 4400000000 )); then
+    available=$(awk '$1=="inactive_file" {print $2}' "$group/memory.stat")
+    requested=$((current - 4000000000))
+    (( requested > available )) && requested=$available
+    if (( requested > 0 )); then
+      printf '%s swappiness=0\n' "$requested" > "$group/memory.reclaim" 2>/dev/null || true
+    fi
+  fi
+  {
+    date -u +%FT%TZ
+    printf 'parent_memory_bytes=%s\n' "$current"
+    systemctl --user show "$export_unit" -p MemoryCurrent -p MemorySwapCurrent
+    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader
+  } >> "$packet/export_resource_samples.log"
+  sleep 5
+done
+[[ $(systemctl --user show "$export_unit" -p Result --value) == success ]]
+[[ $(systemctl --user show "$export_unit" -p ExecMainStatus --value) == 0 ]]
