+"""Run the frozen prediction preflight or post-export audit."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from prediction_artifact_validation import _absent, _base, _json, _pin, _sha
+from prediction_export_audit import _export, _fit_args_by_name
+
+RECIPE_SHA256 = "e34fa919ad49330bcb9ee8f06208da2346eda729d7462be49455d55078c00c25"
+INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256 = "ef81bfeb79bcf9cf971e663c158ccff14a99e22aa0c0159a3ff623034634ccd5"
+
+
+def _execution_records(root: Path, source_commit: str) -> tuple[Path, Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Check and return the admitted recipe and its frozen input receipt."""
+    directory = root / "research/campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/nll_adaptation"
+    recipe_path, verification_path = (
+        directory / "recipe.json",
+        directory / "input_verification.json",
+    )
+    if _sha(recipe_path) != RECIPE_SHA256 or _sha(verification_path) != INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("frozen recipe or input-verification receipt changed")
+    verification = _json(verification_path)
+    if (
+        verification.get("recipe_sha256") != RECIPE_SHA256
+        or verification.get("source_commit") != source_commit
+        or verification.get("source_module_digests_match") is not True
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("input-verification receipt does not bind the frozen recipe/source")
+    return recipe_path, verification_path, verification
+
+
+def _producer_tree(worktree: Path, commit: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Require pinned producer code and reject untracked Python files."""
+    diff = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            "git",
+            "-C",
+            str(worktree),
+            "diff",
+            "--quiet",
+            commit,
+            "--",
+            "src/wnn",
+            "scripts",
+            "utils.py",
+        ],
+        check=False,
+        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    if diff.returncode != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"producer code differs from {commit}: {diff.stderr.strip()}")
+    untracked = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            "git",
+            "-C",
+            str(worktree),
+            "ls-files",
+            "--others",
+            "--",
+            "src/wnn",
+            "scripts",
+            "utils.py",
+        ],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    ).stdout.splitlines()
+    python_files = [path for path in untracked if path.endswith(".py")]
+    if python_files:
+        raise ValueError(f"untracked producer Python files: {python_files}")
+    return {
+        "worktree": str(worktree),
+        "base_commit": commit,
+        "tracked_code_diff": False,
+        "untracked_python": [],
+    }
+
+
+def _expected_ancestry(
+    plan: dict[str, Any],
+    recipe: dict[str, Any],
+    verification: dict[str, Any],
+    fit_args: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Resolve the exact parent, propensity, and target-cache provenance pins."""
+    root = Path(plan["source_pins"]["project_root"])
+    parent = next(item for item in plan["endpoints"] if item["id"] == "parent_cp5")
+    inputs = {str(Path(item["path"])): item for item in verification["inputs"]}
+    children = list(fit_args.values())
+    propensities = {item["propensity"] for item in children}
+    cache_roots = {item["distill_cache_root"] for item in children}
+    if len(children) != 2 or len(propensities) != 1 or len(cache_roots) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("matched child recipes must share one propensity and target cache")
+    propensity_path = root / "artifacts/runs" / next(iter(propensities)) / "model.pt"
+    propensity_pin = inputs.get(str(propensity_path))
+    cache_root = Path(next(iter(cache_roots)))
+    target_cache = recipe["target_cache"]
+    metadata_path = cache_root / "metadata.json"
+    metadata_pin = inputs.get(str(metadata_path))
+    if (
+        propensity_pin is None
+        or metadata_pin is None
+        or metadata_pin.get("sha256") != target_cache["metadata_sha256"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("input receipt omits the fitted ancestry or cache metadata")
+    verified_files = {}
+    for filename, digest in target_cache["target_sha256"].items():
+        file_pin = inputs.get(str(cache_root / filename))
+        if file_pin is None or file_pin.get("sha256") != digest:
+            raise ValueError(f"input receipt target pin differs: {filename}")
+        verified_files[Path(filename).stem] = digest
+    return {
+        "initial_checkpoint_sha256": parent["checkpoint_sha256"],
+        "propensity_checkpoint_sha256": propensity_pin["sha256"],
+        "distillation_cache": {
+            "metadata_sha256": target_cache["metadata_sha256"],
+            "verified_files": verified_files,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run preflight or post-export audit and write a create-only receipt."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("preflight", "post-export"), required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--plan", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--preflight-receipt", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--post-receipt", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.phase == "post-export" and args.preflight_receipt is None:
+        parser.error("--preflight-receipt is required for post-export")
+    if args.phase == "preflight" and args.post_receipt is None:
+        parser.error("--post-receipt is required for preflight")
+    if args.phase == "post-export" and args.post_receipt is not None:
+        parser.error("--post-receipt is only valid for preflight")
+    receipt = args.receipt.resolve()
+    try:
+        if receipt.exists():
+            raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to overwrite receipt: {receipt}")
+        plan_path, eval_path = args.plan.resolve(), args.evaluation_manifest.resolve()
+        plan_preview = _json(plan_path)
+        root = Path(plan_preview["source_pins"]["project_root"])
+        source_commit = plan_preview["source_pins"]["training_source_commit"]
+        recipe_path, verification_path, verification = _execution_records(root, source_commit)
+        plan, _, split, components, base = _base(plan_path, eval_path, verification)
+        base["source_identities"].extend(
+            [_pin(recipe_path, RECIPE_SHA256), _pin(verification_path, INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256)]
+        )
+        worktree = Path(plan["source_pins"]["predictor"]["path"]).parents[1]
+        producer_tree = _producer_tree(worktree, source_commit)
+        recipe = _json(recipe_path)
+        fit_args = _fit_args_by_name(recipe)
+        ancestry = _expected_ancestry(plan, recipe, verification, fit_args)
+        audit_dir = Path(__file__).parent
+        validator_files = [
+            Path(__file__),
+            audit_dir / "prediction_artifact_validation.py",
+            audit_dir / "prediction_export_audit.py",
+        ]
+        validator_identity = {str(path.resolve()): _sha(path) for path in validator_files}
+        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "status": "PASS",
+            "phase": args.phase,
+            "created_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
+            "validator_modules_sha256": validator_identity,
+            "plan": {"path": str(plan_path), "sha256": _sha(plan_path)},
+            "evaluation_manifest": {"path": str(eval_path), "sha256": _sha(eval_path)},
+            "execution_recipe": {"path": str(recipe_path), "sha256": _sha(recipe_path)},
+            "producer_execution_tree": producer_tree,
+            **base,
+        }
+        if args.phase == "preflight":
+            payload["new_output_paths_absent"] = _absent(plan, receipt, args.post_receipt.resolve())
+            payload["completed_checkpoints"] = [
+                _export(
+                    root,
+                    item,
+                    split,
+                    components,
+                    plan["source_pins"]["split_manifest"]["sha256"],
+                    expected_args=fit_args.get(item["run"]),
+                    expected_ancestry=ancestry if item["run"] in fit_args else None,
+                    check_predictions=False,
+                )
+                for item in plan["endpoints"]
+                if item.get("argv")
+            ]
+        else:
+            pre_path = args.preflight_receipt.resolve()
+            pre = _json(pre_path)
+            if (
+                pre.get("status") != "PASS"
+                or pre.get("phase") != "preflight"
+                or pre.get("plan", {}).get("sha256") != payload["plan"]["sha256"]
+                or pre.get("evaluation_manifest", {}).get("sha256")
+                != payload["evaluation_manifest"]["sha256"]
+                or pre.get("execution_recipe") != payload["execution_recipe"]
+                or pre.get("source_identities") != payload["source_identities"]
+                or pre.get("producer_execution_tree") != payload["producer_execution_tree"]
+                or not pre.get("new_output_paths_absent")
+                or pre.get("validator_modules_sha256") != validator_identity
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "preflight receipt does not bind this plan and evaluation manifest"
+                )
+            payload["preflight_receipt"] = {"path": str(pre_path), "sha256": _sha(pre_path)}
+            prior = {row["id"]: row for row in pre.get("completed_checkpoints", [])}
+            exports = []
+            for item in plan["endpoints"]:
+                if not item.get("argv"):
+                    continue
+                current = _export(
+                    root,
+                    item,
+                    split,
+                    components,
+                    plan["source_pins"]["split_manifest"]["sha256"],
+                    expected_args=fit_args.get(item["run"]),
+                    expected_ancestry=ancestry if item["run"] in fit_args else None,
+                )
+                earlier = prior.get(item["id"], {})
+                if (
+                    any(
+                        current.get(field, {}).get("sha256") != earlier.get(field, {}).get("sha256")
+                        for field in ("checkpoint", "provenance")
+                    )
+                    or current.get("fit_args") != earlier.get("fit_args")
+                    or current.get("lineage_pins") != earlier.get("lineage_pins")
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"{item['id']} checkpoint/provenance changed since pre-export binding"
+                    )
+                exports.append(current)
+            payload["new_exports"] = exports
+        receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        with receipt.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(payload, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
+            stream.write("\n")
+    except (
+        OSError,
+        subprocess.SubprocessError,
+        ValueError,
+        KeyError,
+        TypeError,
+        IndexError,
+        AttributeError,
+    ) as exc:
+        print(
+            json.dumps({"status": "FAIL", "phase": args.phase, "error": str(exc)}), file=sys.stderr
+        )
+        raise SystemExit(2) from exc
+    print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS", "phase": args.phase, "receipt": str(receipt)}))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def digest(path: Path, offset: int = 0) -> str:
+    """Hash a file or its declared suffix without materializing it."""
+    value = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        stream.seek(offset)
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            value.update(block)
+    return value.hexdigest()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Verify frozen source, local input identities and small model artifacts."""
+    directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    recipe_path = directory / "recipe.json"
+    recipe = json.loads(recipe_path.read_text())
+    source = recipe["source"]
+    worktree = Path(source["worktree"])
+    subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "diff", "--exit-code", "HEAD", "--", "src", "scripts", "pyproject.toml"],
+        cwd=worktree,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    for name, expected in source["files_sha256"].items():
+        if digest(worktree / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"source digest mismatch: {name}")
+    records = []
+    for item in recipe["preflight_actual_byte_checks"]:
+        path = Path(item["path"])
+        before = path.stat()
+        identity = item.get("frozen_identity")
+        record = {"path": str(path), "bytes": before.st_size, "mtime_ns": before.st_mtime_ns}
+        if identity:
+            if (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (identity["bytes"], identity["mtime_ns"]):
+                raise ValueError(f"frozen source metadata mismatch: {path}")
+            observed = digest(path, before.st_size - identity["footer_bytes"] - 8)
+            if observed != identity["footer_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"Parquet footer mismatch: {path}")
+            record["footer_sha256"] = observed
+        else:
+            observed = digest(path)
+            expected = item.get("sha256", "")
+            if len(expected) == 64 and observed != expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"artifact digest mismatch: {path}")
+            if "bytes" in item and before.st_size != item["bytes"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"artifact size mismatch: {path}")
+            record["sha256"] = observed
+            record["matched_prior_digest"] = len(expected) == 64
+        after = path.stat()
+        if (before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
+            after.st_ino,
+            after.st_size,
+            after.st_mtime_ns,
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"artifact changed during identity check: {path}")
+        records.append(record)
+    result = {
+        "schema": "wnn.overnight.input-verification.v1",
+        "recipe_sha256": digest(recipe_path),
+        "source_commit": source["commit"],
+        "source_module_digests_match": True,
+        "inputs": records,
+        "passed": True,
+        "scope": "No tensor/data array loading, training or quality evaluation.",
+    }
+    with (directory / "input_verification.json").open("x") as output:
+        output.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "input_count": len(records)}), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Conditional NLL follow-up: fold 1
+
+**Status: `NOT_ADMITTED`.** This directory freezes a possible two-fit follow-up after the active fold-0 WMSE/NLL pair is independently graded. It does not launch or authorize work. The exact command arrays, source pins, metadata hashes, admission gate, and production-path feasibility notes are in [F1_FOLLOWUP_PLAN_R1.json](F1_FOLLOWUP_PLAN_R1.json).
+
+## Proposed comparison
+
+The prospective panel is one matched WMSE fit and one matched Gaussian NLL fit on fold 1, both from `oldz4_h230_parent_f1_s3_r4@ep3`, fit seed 4, strict FP32, two epochs, fixed zero-based CP1, batch 16, chunk 2000, clip 1, inherited preprocessing, alpha 0.9, and cache scale 1.0. It reuses the recorded eight-source/four-family fold-1 cache and fold-1 propensity. Both arms keep `--loss wmse`; only `--mean-variance-objective` differs. The family head stays off, so this parent is 23 rows and the NLL child is 25 rows after adding the two logvariance rows. The `h230` run/cache names do not describe hidden width; provenance records H256×2.
+
+This is 2 total new fits (1 per arm), no teacher fits, and no exact WMSE control reused from F0. The plan estimates 2.5 hours for both fits plus 45 minutes for exports. F1's 457 evaluation groups across 149 components are previously exposed. Its score is robustness evidence, not a fresh-holdout estimate.
+
+Do not read a F0-to-F1 score difference as an objective effect: F0 uses a different parent family, seed, fold and three-teacher homogeneous cache. Only the within-F1 WMSE/NLL pair is matched. F0's current clipping diagnostics are recorded as optimization diagnostics in the machine-readable plan; they do not change the frozen clip value and are not quality results.
+
+## All-data production route
+
+The most concrete reusable production starting point in the catalog is `bd26_h230_all_data_student_gru256_seed3_history_swap_v2@ep1` with `cache/h230_all_data_history_swap_v2`; provenance records full train/valid membership and an available parent history checkpoint. For this route, its 31-row family-enabled head can become 33 rows by appending two logvariance rows; this is a distinct production adaptation from the 25-row F0/F1 student.
+
+The recorded history-swap route offers zero new teacher fits or exports if its actual bytes and hashes verify. It preserves the existing mixed clean-fold/all-data history ancestry and the family head, so its model path is 31→33. A separate, unverified route could reuse the eight existing fold-1 teacher checkpoints and their frozen coefficients to complete only the main target cache; it would pair the fold-1 23-row no-family initializer with a 25-row NLL child if the family objective stays off. The current cache covers 10,533 train and 1,416 valid fit groups, so inference must fill 73 excluded train groups and 457 evaluation valid groups. This requires no teacher fits if the existing checkpoints verify, but the eight-teacher inference and cache-build cost is unmeasured. That route also needs an explicit all-data validator that permits a fold-trained initializer while preserving its ancestry and exposure. The pinned NLL trainer rejects variant `history`, and its fold cache validator requires clean-fold membership and evaluation-group exclusion. Neither production route has a validated runnable command here.
+
+## Sources and limits
+
+- [Current NLL adaptation packet](../nll_adaptation/README.md) defines the active F0 experiment and its frozen trainer source.
+- [Fold asset catalog](../nll_adaptation/FOLD_ASSET_CATALOG_R1.md) records the fold-1 parent, cache and propensity ancestry and the all-data candidate assets.
+- The trainer source is pinned to commit `68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440` in `/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/overnight-nll-adaptation-20261020`; no trainer source was changed here.
+- This packet is recipe work only. No fitting, export, array loading, score, or grader change occurred.
+
+## Frozen evaluation and independent review
+
+The [two-endpoint score specification](score_screen_f1_r1.json) compares NLLCP1
+minus WMSECP1 on the457F1 evaluation groups/149components with2000paired
+component-bootstrap resamples, seed271828, unchanged official scoring and no
+coefficient/checkpoint search. Exact scorer argv, output path and source hashes
+are frozen in the plan before fitting. Parent/TL3/blend comparisons are absent
+from this minimal replication; F0 has their separate declared diagnostics.
+
+Independent Luna/max review confirms fit/cache/head/propensity/source semantics
+and exposed-fold limitations. The initial interpreter-path and allocator-cap
+issues were corrected before integration. The review identified missing scorer
+freezing, now supplied here. Actual execution-host preflight is still required:
+verify bytes, row order, full teacher/initializer exclusion, inherited normalizer
+identities, clean output paths, source and available resources. Static review
+is not execution admission.

+        or side.get("dtype") != "float32"
+        or list(map(int, side.get("row_groups", []))) != expected_groups

+"""Grade three frozen complete TL3 endpoints on the same exposed F0 groups."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse

+

+

+
+
+def _compare(
+    targets: np.ndarray,
+    mask: np.ndarray,
+    components: np.ndarray,
+    candidate: np.ndarray,
+    reference: np.ndarray,
+    label: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Compute one fixed paired component bootstrap with canonical arithmetic."""
+    from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap, paired_component_moments
+
+    candidate_moments, reference_moments = paired_component_moments(
+        targets, candidate, reference, mask
+    )
+    return {
+        "comparison": label,
+        "paired_component_bootstrap": paired_component_bootstrap(
+            candidate_moments,
+            reference_moments,
+            components,
+            n_boot=2_000,
+            seed=271_828,
+            centered=True,
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def grade(root: Path, plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Score only the three fixed full endpoints on the exposed F0 panel."""
+    from wnn.gmetric import global_wp
+
+    values = load_screen_inputs(root.resolve(strict=True), plan)
+    targets = values["targets"]
+    mask = values["mask"]
+    components = values["components"]
+    baseline = values["baseline"]
+    candidates = values["candidates"]
+    scores = {
+        "original_tl3": global_wp(targets, baseline, mask),
+        "h512_cp5_replacement": global_wp(targets, candidates["cp5"], mask),
+        "h512_swa345_replacement": global_wp(targets, candidates["swa345"], mask),
+    }
+    comparisons = [
+        _compare(
+            targets,
+            mask,
+            components,
+            candidates["cp5"],
+            baseline,
+            "h512_cp5_replacement - original_tl3",
+        ),
+        _compare(
+            targets,
+            mask,
+            components,
+            candidates["swa345"],
+            baseline,
+            "h512_swa345_replacement - original_tl3",
+        ),
+        _compare(
+            targets,
+            mask,
+            components,
+            candidates["swa345"],
+            candidates["cp5"],
+            "h512_swa345_replacement - h512_cp5_replacement",
+        ),
+    ]
+    return {
+        "schema": "wnn.h512-tl3-endpoint-screen-grade.v1",
+        "status": "GRADED_F0_FITTED_DIAGNOSTIC",
+        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA256,
+        "official_metric": "global_wp_clip2_v1",
+        "target_identity": values["target_identity"],
+        "endpoint_scores": scores,
+        "fixed_comparisons": comparisons,
+        "endpoint_sources": values["source_receipts"],

+        "selection": "Three predeclared endpoints only; no coefficient, epoch, or member search.",
+        "evidence_limit": "F0 is exposed. The two retained TL3 members have unknown ancestry; all complete ensemble deltas are fitted diagnostics, not clean CV evidence.",
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Write the fixed endpoint grade as create-only JSON."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = args.root.resolve(strict=True)
+    plan_path = root / PACKET / "ENDPOINT_SCREEN_PLAN_R1.json"
+    if sha256_file(plan_path) != PLAN_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("endpoint screen plan bytes differ from frozen plan")
+    plan = read_json(plan_path)
+    output = physical_scratch(args.output)
+    if output.parent != SCRATCH_ROOT.resolve(strict=True) or output.exists():

+    started = time.monotonic()

+    report["grade_script_sha256"] = sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve())
+    report["input_helper_sha256"] = sha256_file(
+        Path(__file__).with_name("endpoint_score_inputs.py")
+    )
+    report["contract_sha256"] = sha256_file(Path(__file__).with_name("endpoint_contract.py"))
+    report["wall_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
+    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "status": report["status"],
+                "output": str(output),
+                "scores": report["endpoint_scores"],
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Conditional TL3 student member adaptation
+
+**Status: `NOT_ADMITTED`.** This packet describes a production route to adapt the existing plain TL3 student after the fold-0 and any admitted fold-1 WMSE/NLL comparisons are graded. It does not convert weights, train, export, or create a submission archive. The metadata-only plan is in [TL3_MEMBER_ADAPTATION_PLAN_R1.json](TL3_MEMBER_ADAPTATION_PLAN_R1.json).
+
+## Proposed endpoint
+
+Replace only TL3's `weights_s5.npz` member (`distilled_s5@ep1`, coefficient 0.34) with a final all-data NLL-adapted version of that same student. Keep `weights_tl5.npz` and `weights_tl6.npz` at 0.33 each. Keep the original `solution.py` and all three `wnn_cpp` binaries. This preserves three model calls per row and the existing support for the tied members' 263-wide input projection; the Rust native frontend does not support that layout.
+
+The selected plain member has a metadata-compatible canonical `RNNModel`: 211 inputs, H256, two GRU layers, one hidden readout layer, two outputs, and the 16 state entries including `mean` and `std`. Convert it only after strict shape/key/state round-trip checks. The source archive's teacher, initializer, and fitting membership remain unknown; its description calls the parents all-data, which is not verification. Preserve that ancestry as unknown and use the derived member for production only.
+
+## Conditional training path
+
+If the F0/F1 evidence supports NLL and the controller admits a production fit, initialize from the converted two-output student, append two zero-initialized logvariance rows (2→4), and train one full-data production student fit. The family and auxiliary objectives remain off. +# TL3 single-member H512 packager
+
+**Status: an engineering fixture ZIP and native callback checks pass; no new trained candidate is promoted.** The [packager](../../../../scripts/package_tl3_h512_member.py) creates a new archive from the pinned TL3 ZIP and replaces only `weights_s5.npz`. It uses the existing checkpoint exporter, pinned archive verifier and canonical architecture checker. The original `solution.py`, three `wnn_cpp` libraries, two 263-input NPZ files and blend coefficients are hash-checked and preserved. The packager requires explicit checkpoint, run directory, output directory and artifact role; the output directory must be new and under physical `research_tmp`.
+
+It accepts only an FP32 canonical 211-input H512×1 GRU with two outputs, requires its provenance sidecar, changes only the student `name` in `members.json`, and rejects an archive at or above 20,000,000 bytes. Its receipt records checkpoint and provenance hashes, source archive and entry hashes, exported tensor hashes, resulting ZIP and entry hashes, and code hashes. It does not load or score targets, run native inference, or claim quality or runtime.
+
+## Engineering fixture command
+
+The old `student_frontier_f0s3_h512_l1_r2@ep0` artifact exists for exercising this code path only. It has weak historical quality and must never be treated as a submission candidate or evidence for H512 promotion.
+
+```sh
+cd /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack
+WNN_MEM_MAX=1200000000 WNN_CPU_QUOTA=100% WNN_THREADS=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= \
+  scripts/limited env PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src" \
+  /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack/.venv/bin/python \
+  scripts/package_tl3_h512_member.py \
+  --run-reference student_frontier_f0s3_h512_l1_r2@ep0 \
+  --runs-dir /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack/artifacts/runs \
+  --output-dir /home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/tl3-h512-engineering-fixture-20261021-r1 \
+  --artifact-role engineering_fixture
+```
+
+The bounded callback probe below exercises two complete validation sequences in A–B–A order through the unchanged TL3 wrapper. It checks import, finite two-output rows, warmup behavior and reset/replay determinism. It reads features only and computes no score.
+
+```sh
+cd /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack
+WNN_MEM_MAX=1200000000 WNN_CPU_QUOTA=100% WNN_THREADS=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= \
+OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 \
+  scripts/limited /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack/.venv-py311-profile/bin/python - \
+  /home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/tl3-h512-engineering-fixture-20261021-r1/submission.zip \
+  /home/vlad/development/wunder/wnn_connectome_starterpack/datasets/valid.parquet <<'PY'
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import zipfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+from utils import FEATURE_COLUMNS, DataPoint, SEQUENCE_LENGTH, validate_sequence
+
+zip_path, data_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+scratch = Path("/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp")
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tl3-h512-probe-", dir=scratch) as temporary:
+    package = Path(temporary)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as archive:
+        if archive.testzip() is not None:
+            raise ValueError("candidate ZIP failed CRC validation")
+        archive.extractall(package)
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tl3_probe_solution", package / "solution.py")
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError("candidate ZIP has no loadable solution.py")
+    solution = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(solution)
+    model = solution.PredictionModel()
+    parquet = pq.ParquetFile(data_path)
+
+    def replay(group: int) -> tuple[int, np.ndarray]:
+        table = parquet.read_row_group(
+            group, columns=["seq_ix", "step_in_seq", "need_prediction", *FEATURE_COLUMNS],
+            use_threads=False,
+        )
+        sequence, need = validate_sequence(table)
+        features = np.column_stack([table[name].to_numpy() for name in FEATURE_COLUMNS]).astype(
+            np.float32, copy=False
+        )
+        if len(features) != SEQUENCE_LENGTH:
+            raise ValueError("probe row group is not a complete sequence")
+        outputs = np.zeros((SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2), dtype=np.float32)
+        for step, row in enumerate(features):
+            value = model.predict(DataPoint(sequence, step, bool(need[step]), row))
+            if not need[step]:
+                if value is not None:
+                    raise ValueError("warmup callback must return None")
+                continue
+            value = np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float32)
+            if value.shape != (2,) or not np.isfinite(value).all():
+                raise ValueError("required callback rows must have two finite outputs")
+            outputs[step] = value
+        return sequence, outputs
+
+    first = replay(0)
+    second = replay(1)
+    first_again = replay(0)
+    if first[0] == second[0] or not np.array_equal(
+        first[1].view(np.uint32), first_again[1].view(np.uint32)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("sequence reset/replay check failed")
+    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "groups": [0, 1, 0], "zip_sha256": hashlib.sha256(zip_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "scope": "engineering fixture only; no metric"}, sort_keys=True))
+PY
+```

+  --output-dir /home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp/tl3-h512-production-r1 \

+
+This packages an all-data model as a production candidate; it creates no clean-fold evidence. The separate callback probe, native comparison, runtime measurement, package acceptance and quality decision remain for root and an independent reviewer. The original builder handoff ran no model checks; the controller subsequently ran the actual checks recorded below.
+
+## Integration review
+
+Root independently inspected the packager and reused helpers; archive preservation, dimensions, dtype, finite/positive normalization, create-only output and provenance binding have no identified static blocker. Builder commit a3a4a0b769a916970368bcc349525ba0c165f7c8 adds the positive-std guard. Packaging uses the existing main Python environment because the native-only Python 3.11 environment has no Torch; the callback probe uses Python 3.11. Actual checks below must be bound to their emitted receipts.
+
+## Actual engineering checks
+
+The [fixture build](ENGINEERING_BUILD_RECEIPT_R1.json) produced a 17,091,324-byte
+ZIP with SHA `0d660feb7419e01bcf613a5f906cc17d853509e282fb10495d19f41986dfb10c`.
+Its payload remains in physical scratch; it uses the old weak H512 artifact
+solely to test architecture compatibility. **Do not submit this fixture.**
+
+The [Python 3.11 callback probe](ENGINEERING_CALLBACK_PROBE_R1.json) passes the
+original v3 native wrapper on full feature-only sequences in A–B–A order:
+finite two-target predictions, correct warmup behavior, and bitwise reset/replay.
+No labels or metric were read. Peak process RSS was 334 MB.
+
+The [alternating relative-cost check](ENGINEERING_RELATIVE_COST_R1.json) uses
+the same two full groups, three repeats and the original TL3 ZIP as baseline.
+Median callback-loop sequence times were 2.9103 s for TL3 and 3.7918 s for the
+H512 fixture, a ratio of 1.303. Replays remained bitwise equal within each
+endpoint. Peak process RSS was 349 MB. Shared-machine timing varies; this is
+relative architecture cost, not measured official runtime or candidate quality.
+
+An independent static review by `nll_followup_recipe` found no archive/tensor
+construction blocker. The packager is a byte transformer: its operator-supplied
+artifact role and separately recorded provenance hash do not establish fitting
+membership, admission or ancestry. Root must validate the chosen checkpoint
+against its accepted terminal receipt before production packaging. Final native
+quality, precision behavior and target runtime remain unmeasured.

+# Mean of parent and WMSE continuation checkpoints
+
+**Proposed compatibility review only. No new fit, average, export or quality grade.**
+
+The [contract](CONTRACT_R1.json) fixes one candidate: the equal parameter mean of the existing T3 parent CP5 and the completed WMSE continuation CP0/CP1. It reuses the canonical averaging helper and requires exact topology and normalization-buffer compatibility. Primary comparison is its fixed 75/25 oldZ4 blend against the existing 75/25 oldZ4/WMSE CP1 blend. There is no coefficient search or additional training replication.
+
+The possible benefit is a better position along a shared optimization trajectory with the same recurrent inference architecture. This is an inference to test, not a measured gain. The two-epoch AdamW continuation differs from the cyclical/constant-SGD setting of the original SWA paper and from the vision/language fine-tuning examples in model soups. A parent and its children share ancestry and are not independent models or seeds. All F0 selection is exposed development evidence; a final complete native endpoint must earn its place.
+
+References: [SWA](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.05407), [model soups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.05482). Root verified these primary abstracts before proposing the local adaptation. They motivate weight averaging but do not establish benefit for this dataset. Source runs and actual metrics remain in the [WMSE/NLL packet](../nll_adaptation/README.md).
+
+The [independent critique](INDEPENDENT_CRITIQUE_R1.json) accepts a bounded compatibility probe but notes the mean may pull the child back toward its weaker initializer. It confirms metadata links parent CP5 to the child initialization and locates both child snapshots. Tensor/buffer equality remains unverified. The canonical tensor mean is reusable; its epochs-3/4/5 derivation wrapper is unsuitable for this cross-run lineage. No score or shipping approval.

+# Kaggle delivery readiness — October 21
+
+**Status: metadata-only; no cloud fit admitted.** This receipt evaluates the candidate F1 WMSE/NLL pair and the cold H512 fallback against the current Kaggle quota, existing data assets, and the provider's actual kernel metadata interface. It records no score or profile result.
+
+## Findings
+
+A fresh read-only SDK quota query at `2026-10-20T23:09:10Z` found **18,076.427 GPU seconds (5.0212 hours) unreserved**, zero provider-reserved seconds, and refresh at October 24 UTC. The WNN kernel search returned no refs stamped October 20 or 21; three exact historical status queries returned `COMPLETE`. The installed Kaggle SDK can list notebook metadata and query one known kernel's status, but does not expose an account-wide running-session roster. The current campaign has no recorded planned reservation from another agent; the quota snapshot cannot establish plans that were never submitted to Kaggle.
+
+The Kaggle dataset `vladkochetov07/wunder-funder` already contains the exact root inputs: `train.parquet` at 29,240,219,011 bytes and `valid.parquet` at 5,615,509,128 bytes, plus `valid_mask.parquet` at 91,972,846 bytes. The dataset is **public**, not private. Dataset detail and the per-file sum agree at 34,947,700,985 bytes; the dataset-list aggregate is 33,761,236,515 bytes, so use the per-file sizes for identity.
+
+No F1 target cache, propensity, or initializer was found in that Kaggle dataset inventory. The F1 parent checkpoint, target cache and propensity assets are recorded as local assets in the existing [fold asset catalog](../../campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/nll_adaptation/FOLD_ASSET_CATALOG_R1.md). The target cache is about 2 GB. A Kaggle F1 run therefore needs those exact local assets staged as private inputs through the existing bundle flow.
+
+The existing [bundle builder](../../../scripts/kaggle_bundle.py) requests `machine_shape=NvidiaTeslaT4`. Kaggle's current [kernel metadata documentation](https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/kernels_metadata.md) identifies that shape as **two T4 GPUs**, and lists `NvidiaL4` without a device count. The installed root SDK's supported-value list instead contains T4, P100, and the older TPU v3 shape, omitting L4; this is interface-version drift. Neither the SDK nor the quota response reports which GPU shapes are currently available to this account. P100 is an accepted identifier, but availability was not established; no single-GPU shape was verified as available. The quota response has aggregate GPU seconds and no per-device billing multiplier, so this audit does not treat a dual-T4 hour as either one or two quota hours.
+
+## Candidate lane and gates
+
+The **F1 pair is the nearest candidate**: one WMSE and one NLL fit, with a plan estimate of 2.5 hours of fit time plus 45 minutes for exports. At 3.25 hours total, that would leave about 1.77 hours if quota tracks session wall time one-for-one. If two T4s were charged independently, the same wall-time estimate would consume 6.5 hours and exceed the current 5.02-hour remainder. Both are planning scenarios: actual Kaggle throughput and quota treatment remain unmeasured. F1 remains `NOT_ADMITTED` until the local F0 pair is scored and independently graded.
+
+Before reconsidering F1, the controller needs to:
+
+1. Wait for the active R2 exports and score, then apply the frozen F1 value-of-information gate.
+2. Stage the exact parent, target, and propensity assets privately. Reuse `kaggle_bundle.py`, `kaggle_assets.py`, `kaggle_gpu_runner.py`, and `kaggle_common.py`; use the canonical trainer, with no new trainer.
+3. Confirm a currently accessible machine shape, then run a bounded representative profile and reconcile before/after quota seconds.
+4. Reserve the measured profile, two fits, exports, artifact collection, and recovery margin against the **observed** quota charge before admission.
+
+The H512 alternative is less ready. Its plan describes a 360-second local profile and a six-epoch H512×1 recipe, but has no Kaggle actual-shape profile or Kaggle fit-cost estimate. It is not a quota-feasible lane yet; the same sealed runner/bundle path can be used after profiling.
+
+## Scope and provenance
+
+The SDK checks used the root `.venv` Kaggle package (version 2.2.4) and the existing read-only [`poll_provider.py`](../../campaign_2026-10-06/cloud_preflight/poll_provider.py) client-timeout helper. API work ran under a 20% CPU quota, 300 MiB memory maximum, zero swap, and `TMPDIR=/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp`. No credentials were printed or changed, no package was installed, and no dataset was uploaded or kernel launched.
+
+The [machine-readable receipt](KAGGLE_DELIVERY_READINESS_20261021_R1.json) contains the exact quota values, dataset file sizes, asset hashes, kernel-status sample, assumptions, and blockers. The accepted [local/Kaggle plan](../../../specs/plans/2026-10-20-plateau-review-local-kaggle.md), current [frontier](../../campaign_2026-10-20/plateau_review_r1/FRONTIER.md), [F1 plan](../../campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/nll_followup_f1/F1_FOLLOWUP_PLAN_R1.json), and [H512 profile plan](../../campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/h512_replication_profile/PROFILE_PLAN_R1.json) remain authoritative for scientific scope and admission.

The workers invoke only the frozen `scripts/predict_run.py` from the B16 producer source closure, in FP32, on the same 457 source-qualified evaluation groups. +from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import signal
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tarfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+
+BUNDLE_SLUG = 'wnn-h512-f1-b16-export-20261021-r1'
+EXPECTED_ARCHIVE_SHA256 = '1802af9b02281097da72c15594ace7c2d5b694218ac19387e10e72e14e5be095'
+EXPECTED_EXTERNAL_MOUNTS = {'datasets/train.parquet': 'train.parquet', 'datasets/valid.parquet': 'valid.parquet'}
+# Kaggle's current maximum kernel session window; each sealed worker spec still
+# carries its own timeout and the runner leaves its finalization reserve.
+KERNEL_PROCESS_WALL_SECONDS_MAX = 1_700
+RUNNER_FINALIZATION_RESERVE_SECONDS = 300
+BOOTSTRAP_STARTED_MONOTONIC = time.monotonic()
+
+
+def remaining_seconds(deadline_monotonic: float, *, now_monotonic: float | None = None) -> float:
+    """Return remaining kernel-process budget from the bootstrap-entry deadline."""
+    now = time.monotonic() if now_monotonic is None else now_monotonic
+    return max(0.0, deadline_monotonic - now)
+
+
+def require_remaining(deadline_monotonic: float, phase: str) -> None:
+    """Fail closed when synchronous bootstrap work has exhausted its deadline."""
+    if remaining_seconds(deadline_monotonic) <= 0:
+        raise TimeoutError(f"kernel bootstrap exceeded its deadline during {phase}")
+
+
+def worker_timeout_for_deadline(
+    declared_seconds: int,
+    deadline_monotonic: float,
+    *,
+    now_monotonic: float | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Shrink a worker cap to leave time for runner artifact collection and exit."""
+    now = time.monotonic() if now_monotonic is None else now_monotonic
+    available = int(
+        deadline_monotonic - now - RUNNER_FINALIZATION_RESERVE_SECONDS
+    )
+    return max(0, min(int(declared_seconds), available))
+
+
+def terminate_process_tree(process: subprocess.Popen, *, grace_seconds: float = 2.0) -> None:
+    """Stop only the runner and its descendants, including workers in new sessions."""
+    try:
+        import psutil
+    except ImportError as error:  # the bundled runner requires psutil as well
+        raise RuntimeError("cannot safely enforce kernel deadline without psutil") from error
+
+    try:
+        root = psutil.Process(process.pid)
+        members = [root, *root.children(recursive=True)]
+    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
+        process.wait()
+        return
+
+    # The runner creates a separate session for each admitted worker. Kill the
+    # process tree by identity, not the bootstrap's process group alone.
+    for child in members[1:]:
+        try:
+            child.terminate()
+        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
+            pass
+    try:
+        root.terminate()
+    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
+        pass
+    _, alive = psutil.wait_procs(members, timeout=grace_seconds)
+    for child in alive:
+        try:
+            child.kill()
+        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
+            pass
+    psutil.wait_procs(alive, timeout=grace_seconds)
+    try:
+        process.wait(timeout=grace_seconds)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        # The Popen itself is also in our process tree; this is a final bounded
+        # fallback if the process changed state during psutil's snapshot.
+        try:
+            os.kill(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        except ProcessLookupError:
+            pass
+        process.wait(timeout=grace_seconds)
+
+
+def write_runtime_spec(source: Path, destination: Path, deadline_monotonic: float) -> int:
+    """Copy a sealed recipe spec with a runtime timeout reduced to current headroom."""
+    spec = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    limits = spec.get("limits")
+    if not isinstance(limits, dict) or not isinstance(limits.get("timeout_seconds"), int):
+        raise ValueError("kernel spec has no integer worker timeout")
+    worker_seconds = worker_timeout_for_deadline(
+        limits["timeout_seconds"], deadline_monotonic
+    )
+    if worker_seconds < 1:
+        raise TimeoutError("kernel deadline leaves no worker time after finalization reserve")
+    limits["timeout_seconds"] = worker_seconds
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = destination.with_suffix(destination.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temporary.replace(destination)
+    return worker_seconds
+
+
+def release_mounts(root: Path, mounts: dict) -> None:
+    """Unlink only external input symlinks before Kaggle captures working outputs."""
+    for logical in mounts:
+        target = root / logical
+        if target.is_symlink():
+            target.unlink()

+

+    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tar:

+            require_remaining(kernel_deadline, "bundle extraction")

+            seen.add(member.name)

+        if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or logical not in allowed:

+## Root conditional admission — October 21
+
+[Final independent review](INDEPENDENT_STATIC_REVIEW_R2.json) passes within static scope. Root independently refreshed [provider quota](ROOT_QUOTA_PRELAUNCH_R2.json): 17,006.922 seconds unreserved, zero reserved. The [actual admission](root_admission.json) permits one fresh B16 profile and a cold six-epoch fit only if measured speed fits the actual deadline, 15,500-second outer cap and 1,200-second quota reserve. The final bundle still needs exact byte verification before upload. No R2 model or quality result exists. Earlier placeholder statements below are historical preparation.
+
+This code-only packet prepares one resource-adapted H512 F1 endpoint from the clean canonical source checkout 68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440. The six worker helpers were transplanted from B8 packet commit ef11a7d07 and changed for batch 16, the R2 run and artifact names, the new update count, and the reduced wall cap. The canonical trainer and src/wnn sources are unchanged.
+
+The exact trainer argv, source identities, code closure and fail-closed gates are in [the proposal](H512_F1_B16_CONDITIONAL_PROFILE_FIT_PROPOSAL_20261021_R2.json) and [execution spec](KAGGLE_F1_B16_CONDITIONAL_EXECUTION_SPEC_R2.json). The run names are r01_h512_f1_s1004_kaggle_profile_r2, r01_h512_f1_s1004_kaggle_fit_r2, and r01_h512_f1_s1004_kaggle_swa345_r2. The worker receipt path is conditional_worker_receipt_r2.json with the existing wnn.kaggle-h512-f1-conditional-worker-receipt.v1 schema.
+
+The fit membership remains 10,533 train plus 1,416 valid sequences (11,949 per epoch). At batch 16 with drop-last, that is 746 batches per epoch, 13 dropped sequences per epoch, 4,476 batches over six epochs, and 44,760 chunk updates. Batch 8 dropped five sequences per epoch and used 89,580 updates. The B8 worker completed a 40-update engineering profile and skipped fitting at its cost gate; its reported provider charge was 270.730 seconds. It provides no quality result. R2 requires a fresh B16 profile with one warmup and three measured batches (40 finite chunk updates). Its measured B16 PROFILE.step_wall feeds the worker exact cost gate. The approximately 2.18-second per-batch threshold is planning context only. The B16 batch and optimizer-clock changes make this a resource adaptation, not a matched width or seed replication.
+
+The recipe retains six epochs, fixed CP5, seed 1004, 211 causal inputs, chunk-normalized original-label WMSE, strict FP32, AdamW at 1e-4, OneCycle warmup fraction 0.05, clipping at 1.0, and an equal-parameter CP3/4/5 SWA endpoint. The conditional full fit uses 4,476 B16 batches. The worker wall cap is 15,200 seconds, with a 300-second finalizer and 15,500-second outer cap; it preserves a 1,200 provider-second safety reserve and records a separate two-device allocation bound. No R2 profile or fit is admitted. The direct provider snapshot reported by the root at 00:48:28 UTC is retained for context only; root admission must use a fresh poll and reservation check.

Structural-cache size/SHA metadata is in private_cache_bundle/assets-manifest.json; the private archive remains in the original B8 worktree at the exact path pinned in the proposal and is not copied here. Stage and hash-check those two cache files before canonical split preflight. Raw train/valid files remain external mounts. KAGGLE_BUNDLE_PREPARATION_R2.json records the exact 170-file code closure but explicitly defers bundle construction until root admission.

+# B16 resource-adapted F1 fixed endpoint screen
+
+**Frozen source plan; independent static review passed:** final proposal is pinned. No grade or fit admission. This separately named packet preserves the unused B8 screen unchanged. B16 keeps six epochs but uses44,760 updates and different optimizer/schedule/sample-drop behavior; report separate fold results, not an identical-arm pooled effect.
+
+# Conditional F1 H512 endpoint screen
+
+**Status: code prepared and statically reviewed; no grade run.** This packet defines one fixed five-endpoint comparison for the conditional seed-1004 H512 F1 fit. It does not admit a fit or promote a model. Grading requires the separate root-authored `F1_FIT_TERMINAL_ACCEPTANCE_R2.json`; the Kaggle worker receipt alone is insufficient.
+
+The [screen plan](F1_FIXED_SCREEN_R2.json) pins the canonical fold-1 manifest, its source-only derived execution view, input registry, official target cache, oldZ4 reference, and official scorer code. The grader checks that only `sources` differs between the canonical and derived manifests, then keeps both hashes in the output. The model receipt and sidecars bind to the derived view. The oldZ4 endpoint remains bound to the unchanged canonical manifest.
+
+The panel contains oldZ4, H512 CP5, H512 SWA345, `0.75 oldZ4 + 0.25 CP5`, and `0.75 oldZ4 + 0.25 SWA345`. All five comparisons and the 2,000-resample component bootstrap seed are fixed in advance. Mixtures use the frozen coefficients; no endpoint or coefficient search is performed. Candidate exports contain the 457 evaluation groups only. The grader aligns those groups to the oldZ4 full-validation cache and scores each sequence through the existing `campaign_score.py` official metric implementation. It derives the selected official row count from the target mask at grading time.
+
+The grader follows the producer's standalone `wnn.kaggle-h512-swa345-weight-derivation.v1` receipt: `equal_parameter_mean_epochs_3_4_5`, exact CP3/CP4/CP5 path and SHA records, canonical and derived manifest identities, initialization and normalization identities, and output path/hash records for `model_ep5.pt`, `provenance.json`, and `model.pt`. It checks those bytes against the root acceptance and requires the derived provenance to preserve the fit arguments and normalization identity.
+
+oldZ4 is a previously fitted, legacy FP16-inference reference; the new endpoints use FP32 inference. This is not a pure precision comparison. Fold 1 has prior evaluation exposure, and these results do not establish a fresh holdout, a public-score forecast, or automatic submission promotion. See the [conditional fit proposal](../kaggle_h512_b16_conditional_f1_r2/README.md) and the prior [F1 source/cache audit](../../campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/nll_adaptation/FOLD_ASSET_CATALOG_R1.md) for ancestry context.
+
+After root has accepted the fit and both fixed exports, run from the project root:
+
+```sh
+python research/campaign_2026-10-21/kaggle_h512_b16_f1_endpoint_grade_r2/grade_h512_f1_screen.py
+```
+
+The create-only output is `F1_FIXED_SCREEN_GRADE_R2.json`. The grader verifies accepted checkpoint, derivation, prediction, sidecar, manifest, target-cache and scorer hashes before and after scoring. Current work is code and metadata only; no predictions were read and no score is available.
+
+[Root terminal acceptance CLI](accept_h512_f1_terminal.py) checks six epoch/update records and strict-FP32 evidence, validates checkpoint/provenance/export identities through the shared packet checker, scans both complete exports for finite values, and recomputes the exact canonical CP3/4/5 weight mean. It writes acceptance create-only and makes no quality or promotion claim. Run under campaign resource limits after root has collected and bound actual successful worker outputs; no execution has occurred.

+"""Accept downloaded B16 artifacts after independent finite and trajectory checks."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+# JSON receipts and checkpoints carry heterogeneous metadata.
+
+import numpy as np
+from f1_grade_contract import (
+    DERIVED_SHA,
+    FIT_NAME,
+    ORIGINAL_SHA,
+    SWA_NAME,
+    artifact_root,
+    check_manifests,
+    pinned,
+    read_json,
+    sha256,
+)
+from f1_grade_outputs import check_worker_outputs
+from grade_h512_f1_screen import PLAN, PLAN_SHA256
+
+
+def check_training_history(base: Path, worker: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check six completed epochs and the recorded strict FP32 update evidence."""
+    run = base / "artifacts/runs" / FIT_NAME
+    history_path = run / "history.json"
+    history = json.loads(history_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    provenance = read_json(run / "provenance.json")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(history, list)
+        or len(history) != 6
+        or [item.get("epoch") for item in history] != list(range(6))
+        or any(item.get("evaluation") != "withheld" for item in history)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Expected six complete fixed-recipe epochs without fit-time evaluation")
+    expected_args = {
+        "arch": "gru",
+        "cell": "gru",
+        "enc": "linear",
+        "hidden": 512,
+        "layers": 1,
+        "dropout": 0.0,
+        "valid_fold": 1,
+        "n_valid_folds": 4,
+        "train_seqs": 10607,
+        "train_source": "train+valid",
+        "valid_train_fraction": 1.0,
+        "valid_repeat": 1,
+        "full_valid": True,
+        "eval_source": "vfold",
+        "batch": 16,
+        "chunk": 2000,
+        "epochs": 6,
+        "checkpoint_policy": "fixed",
+        "checkpoint_epoch": 5,
+        "no_eval_during_fit": True,
+        "seed": 1004,
+        "precision": "fp32",
+        "loss": "wmse",
+        "loss_norm": "chunk",
+        "batch_order": "seeded",
+        "deterministic": True,
+        "sync_free": True,
+        "fused_adam": True,
+        "grad_stats": True,
+        "optim": "adamw",
+        "lr": 0.0001,
+        "beta2": 0.999,
+        "wd": 0.01,
+        "sched": "onecycle",
+        "warmup_frac": 0.05,
+        "head_lr_mult": 1.0,
+        "clip": 1.0,
+    }
+    if any(provenance.get("args", {}).get(key) != value for key, value in expected_args.items()):
+        raise ValueError("Fit arguments differ from the frozen B16 scientific recipe")
+    diagnostics = provenance.get("update_diagnostics", [])
+    if len(diagnostics) != 6:
+        raise ValueError("Incomplete epoch update diagnostics")
+    for epoch, item in enumerate(diagnostics):
+        counts = item.get("epoch", {})
+        if (
+            item.get("epoch_index") != epoch
+            or item.get("normalization_identity") != provenance.get("normalization_identity")
+            or counts.get("optimizer_attempts") != 7460
+            or counts.get("optimizer_completed_updates") != 7460
+            or counts.get("completed_batches") != 746
+            or counts.get("amp_skipped_updates") != 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Incomplete B16 update or normalization evidence at epoch {epoch}")
+    precision = worker.get("precision_audit", {})
+    if precision.get("nvidia_tf32_override") != "0":
+        raise ValueError("Missing worker TF32 override evidence")
+    for phase in (
+        "flags_after_profile",
+        "flags_before_full_fit",
+        "flags_after_full_fit",
+        "flags_after_exports",
+    ):
+        if precision.get(phase) != {"matmul_tf32": False, "cudnn_tf32": False}:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing strict FP32 runtime evidence: {phase}")
+    return {"path": str(history_path), "sha256": sha256(history_path), "epochs": 6}
+
+
+def check_trajectory(root: Path, base: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Recompute the exact canonical equal-weight mean from downloaded CP3/4/5."""
+    import importlib.util
+
+    import torch
+
+    helper_path = root / "scripts/average_trajectory_checkpoints.py"
+    helper_sha = "8646ccc12b537a1bf2f2544dffd85d10287076451e5bab86a4b2d6379e39bbb3"
+    if sha256(helper_path) != helper_sha:
+        raise ValueError("Canonical trajectory helper differs from the reviewed source")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_trajectory_mean", helper_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError("Cannot load the canonical trajectory mean helper")
+    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
+    with torch.serialization.safe_globals([torch.torch_version.TorchVersion]):
+        checkpoints = [
+            torch.load(
+                base / "artifacts/runs" / FIT_NAME / f"model_ep{epoch}.pt",
+                map_location="cpu",
+                weights_only=True,
+            )
+            for epoch in (3, 4, 5)
+        ]
+        derived = torch.load(
+            base / "artifacts/runs" / SWA_NAME / "model_ep5.pt",
+            map_location="cpu",
+            weights_only=True,
+        )
+    for epoch, checkpoint in zip((3, 4, 5), checkpoints, strict=True):
+        if (
+            checkpoint.get("epoch") != epoch
+            or checkpoint.get("n_in") != 211
+            or checkpoint.get("args") != checkpoints[-1].get("args")
+            or checkpoint.get("args", {}).get("split_manifest_sha256") != DERIVED_SHA
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Source checkpoint epoch, input width or fitting arguments differ")
+    if derived.get("epoch") != 5 or derived.get("n_in") != 211:
+        raise ValueError("Derived checkpoint metadata differs from CP5 H512")
+    if any(
+        value.is_floating_point() and value.dtype != torch.float32
+        for checkpoint in [*checkpoints, derived]
+        for value in checkpoint["model"].values()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Checkpoint contains floating model tensors outside FP32")
+    expected = helper.mean_state([checkpoint["model"] for checkpoint in checkpoints])
+    if expected.keys() != derived["model"].keys() or any(
+        not torch.equal(value, derived["model"][name]) for name, value in expected.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Downloaded SWA weights differ from the exact canonical CP3/4/5 mean")
+    if helper_sha != sha256(helper_path):
+        raise ValueError("Trajectory helper changed during recomputation")
+    return {"tensors_bitwise_equal": len(expected), "helper_sha256": helper_sha}
+
+
+def accept(root: Path, base: Path) -> Path:
+    """Write root acceptance only after checking actual downloaded model outputs."""
+    plan = read_json(pinned(root, {"path": PLAN.as_posix(), "sha256": PLAN_SHA256}))
+    if plan.get("status") != "FROZEN_SCREEN_NOT_GRADED":
+        raise ValueError("B16 plan is not frozen")
+    contract = plan["acceptance"]
+    destination = root / contract["path"]
+    if destination.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(destination)
+    worker_path = root / contract["worker_receipt_path"]
+    worker = read_json(worker_path)

+"""Frozen artifact, manifest, and terminal-acceptance checks for the F1 grade."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+FIT_NAME = "r01_h512_f1_s1004_kaggle_fit_r2"
+SWA_NAME = "r01_h512_f1_s1004_kaggle_swa345_r2"
+ORIGINAL_SHA = "31b9dc040761dcc81e99bfe69e0bc446f1522b21ab629b2a9c5a03d94bb006ae"
+DERIVED_SHA = "548b42f06710a0f7c06377b8f2aaf7241469d75f0dad9de05bd4fbc29448d0c3"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one file with bounded memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load a JSON object and reject other root values."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def pinned(root: Path, item: dict[str, str]) -> Path:
+    """Resolve a repository artifact and verify its frozen SHA-256."""
+    path = (root / item["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not path.is_relative_to(root) or sha256(path) != item["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError(f"Frozen artifact mismatch: {path}")
+    return path
+
+
+def artifact_root(root: Path, value: str) -> Path:
+    """Resolve accepted worker outputs under project or physical research scratch."""
+    base = Path(value).expanduser()
+    if not base.is_absolute():
+        base = root / base
+    base = base.resolve(strict=True)
+    scratch = Path("/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp").resolve(strict=True)
+    if not (base.is_relative_to(root) or base.is_relative_to(scratch)):
+        raise ValueError("Accepted artifact_root must be project or physical research scratch")
+    return base
+
+
+def accepted_file(base: Path, relative: str, expected: str) -> Path:
+    """Resolve an accepted output below its declared artifact root and hash it."""
+    path = Path(relative)
+    if path.is_absolute():
+        raise ValueError("Accepted artifact paths must be relative to artifact_root")
+    resolved = (base / path).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not resolved.is_relative_to(base) or sha256(resolved) != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"Accepted artifact bytes differ: {relative}")
+    return resolved
+
+
+def check_acceptance(root: Path, plan: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict, dict, Path]:
+    """Require the separate root terminal acceptance and matching worker evidence."""
+    accept_spec = plan["acceptance"]
+    acceptance_path = (root / accept_spec["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not acceptance_path.is_relative_to(root):
+        raise ValueError("Root acceptance path escaped the project")
+    acceptance = read_json(acceptance_path)
+    if (
+        acceptance.get("schema") != accept_spec["schema"]
+        or acceptance.get("status") != accept_spec["status"]
+        or acceptance.get("fit_run") != FIT_NAME
+        or acceptance.get("original_split_manifest_sha256") != ORIGINAL_SHA
+        or acceptance.get("execution_split_manifest_sha256") != DERIVED_SHA
+        or acceptance.get("worker_receipt_path") != accept_spec["worker_receipt_path"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Root terminal acceptance differs from the frozen F1 contract")
+    worker_path = pinned(
+        root,
+        {"path": acceptance["worker_receipt_path"], "sha256": acceptance["worker_receipt_sha256"]},
+    )
+    worker = read_json(worker_path)
+    if (
+        worker.get("schema") != "wnn.kaggle-h512-f1-conditional-worker-receipt.v1"
+        or worker.get("status") != "CONDITIONAL_FIT_AND_EXPORT_COMPLETE"
+        or worker.get("quality_fit_claim") is not None
+        or worker.get("original_manifest_sha256") != ORIGINAL_SHA
+        or worker.get("derived_manifest_sha256") != DERIVED_SHA
+        or worker.get("run_names") != {"cp5": FIT_NAME, "swa345": SWA_NAME}
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Worker receipt is incomplete or bound to another F1 run")
+    if acceptance.get("artifact_root") is None:
+        raise ValueError("Root acceptance must declare artifact_root for downloaded files")
+    base = artifact_root(root, acceptance["artifact_root"])
+    receipt = worker.get("input_identity", {})
+    if (
+        receipt.get("original_manifest_sha256") != ORIGINAL_SHA
+        or receipt.get("derived_manifest_sha256") != DERIVED_SHA
+        or receipt.get("proposal_sha256") != plan["identity"]["proposal"]["sha256"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Worker source identity receipt differs from the frozen F1 plan")
+    return acceptance, worker, base
+
+
+def check_manifests(root: Path, plan: dict[str, Any], worker: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    """Preserve canonical identity while checking the source-only execution view."""
+    canonical = read_json(pinned(root, plan["identity"]["canonical_manifest"]))
+    derived = read_json(pinned(root, plan["identity"]["derived_execution_manifest"]))
+    registry = read_json(pinned(root, plan["identity"]["portable_registry"]))
+    proposal = read_json(pinned(root, plan["identity"]["proposal"]))
+    if {**canonical, "sources": derived.get("sources")} != derived:
+        raise ValueError("Execution manifest changed a canonical field other than sources")
+    wanted_sources = {
+        key: canonical["sources"][key]
+        for key in ("datasets/train.parquet", "datasets/valid.parquet")
+    }
+    if derived.get("sources") != wanted_sources:
+        raise ValueError("Execution view source metadata differs from canonical F1")
+    if registry.get("split_manifest_sha256") != ORIGINAL_SHA:
+        raise ValueError("Portable data registry is not bound to canonical F1")
+    counts = plan["identity"]["membership"]
+    if (
+        derived.get("fold") != 1
+        or derived.get("n_folds") != 4
+        or derived.get("counts", {}).get("fit_train") != counts["fit_train_groups"]
+        or derived.get("counts", {}).get("fit_valid") != counts["fit_valid_groups"]
+        or derived.get("counts", {}).get("evaluation_valid") != counts["evaluation_groups"]
+        or derived.get("counts", {}).get("evaluation_components") != counts["evaluation_components"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Derived F1 membership counts differ from the frozen screen")
+    receipt = worker["input_identity"]
+    expected_caches = {
+        name: {"bytes": item["size_bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
+        for name, item in proposal["source_assets"]["structural_cache_bundle"]["files"].items()
+    }
+    if receipt.get("cache_files") != expected_caches:
+        raise ValueError("Worker structural cache identities differ from the frozen proposal")
+    if receipt.get("registry_sha256") != plan["identity"]["portable_registry"]["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("Worker portable registry hash differs from the frozen F1 registry")
+    sources = registry.get("sources", {})
+    observed_sources = receipt.get("raw_sources", {})
+    expected_hashes = {
+        "datasets/train.parquet": "4a7756449a4bcf272cf715bb405a2152987041605f6c1cce650243ab2abf4e81",
+        "datasets/valid.parquet": "2861ee30914065702626a3ac033d80d0563cdacaea50c667fc828c2eeb418782",
+    }
+    for name, expected in expected_hashes.items():
+        registered = sources.get(name, {})
+        observed = observed_sources.get(name, {})
+        if registered.get("sha256") != expected or observed.get("sha256") != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"Raw source ancestry changed: {name}")
+        if observed.get("bytes") != registered.get("original_identity", {}).get("bytes"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Raw source size changed: {name}")
+    if (
+        proposal.get("fold_identity", {}).get("derived_execution_view", {}).get("sha256")
+        != DERIVED_SHA
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Conditional proposal does not name the frozen execution view")
+    return canonical, derived

+def score_panel(

+    audit_dir = root / "research/campaign_2026-09-30/audit"

+        "frozen_campaign_score", audit_dir / "campaign_score.py"
+    )
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:

+    scorer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)

+        or oldz4_sidecar.get("split_manifest_sha256") != ORIGINAL_SHA

+def copy_file(source: Path, destination: Path, expected_hash: str | None = None) -> str:

+# Conditional F1 H512 endpoint screen
+
+**Status: frozen grader prepared; no grade run.** This packet defines one fixed five-endpoint comparison for the conditional seed-1004 H512 F1 fit. It does not admit a fit or promote a model. Grading requires the separate root-authored `F1_FIT_TERMINAL_ACCEPTANCE_R1.json`; the Kaggle worker receipt alone is insufficient.
+
+The [screen plan](F1_FIXED_SCREEN_R1.json) pins the canonical fold-1 manifest, its source-only derived execution view, input registry, official target cache, oldZ4 reference, and official scorer code. The grader checks that only `sources` differs between the canonical and derived manifests, then keeps both hashes in the output. The model receipt and sidecars bind to the derived view. The oldZ4 endpoint remains bound to the unchanged canonical manifest.
+
+The panel contains oldZ4, H512 CP5, H512 SWA345, `0.75 oldZ4 + 0.25 CP5`, and `0.75 oldZ4 + 0.25 SWA345`. All five comparisons and the 2,000-resample component bootstrap seed are fixed in advance. Mixtures use the frozen coefficients; no endpoint or coefficient search is performed. Candidate exports contain the 457 evaluation groups only. The grader aligns those groups to the oldZ4 full-validation cache and scores each sequence through the existing `campaign_score.py` official metric implementation. It derives the selected official row count from the target mask at grading time.
+
+The grader follows the producer's standalone `wnn.kaggle-h512-swa345-weight-derivation.v1` receipt: `equal_parameter_mean_epochs_3_4_5`, exact CP3/CP4/CP5 path and SHA records, canonical and derived manifest identities, initialization and normalization identities, and output path/hash records for `model_ep5.pt`, `provenance.json`, and `model.pt`. It checks those bytes against the root acceptance and requires the derived provenance to preserve the fit arguments and normalization identity.
+
+oldZ4 is a previously fitted, legacy FP16-inference reference; the new endpoints use FP32 inference. This is not a pure precision comparison. Fold 1 has prior evaluation exposure, and these results do not establish a fresh holdout, a public-score forecast, or automatic submission promotion. See the [conditional fit proposal](../kaggle_h512_conditional_f1_r1/README.md) and the prior [F1 source/cache audit](../../campaign_2026-10-20/submission_delivery_r1/nll_adaptation/FOLD_ASSET_CATALOG_R1.md) for ancestry context.
+
+After root has accepted the fit and both fixed exports, run from the project root:
+
+```sh
+python research/campaign_2026-10-21/kaggle_h512_f1_endpoint_grade_r1/grade_h512_f1_screen.py
+```
+
+The create-only output is `F1_FIXED_SCREEN_GRADE_R1.json`. The grader verifies accepted checkpoint, derivation, prediction, sidecar, manifest, target-cache and scorer hashes before and after scoring. Current work is code and metadata only; no predictions were read and no score is available.

+# Kaggle H512 engineering profile delivery
+
+This folder preserves two bounded, private Kaggle engineering profile attempts for the frozen H512×1, batch 8, chunk 2000, FP32, fold 0, seed 1003 recipe. They were intended to establish a device and phase cost before considering a scientific fit. Both attempts ended before training; there is no profile measurement, model result, or fit admission.
+
+The terminal receipt [KAGGLE_H512_PROFILE_TERMINAL_20261021_R1.json](KAGGLE_H512_PROFILE_TERMINAL_20261021_R1.json) records provider quota before and after each attempt, requested and actual machine shapes, exact worker deadlines, preserved terminal collections, full raw input identities, and the second failure diagnosis. The original profile recipe is [h512_profile_spec.json](h512_profile_spec.json); attempt 2 added the minimal logging wrapper at [collected wrapper source](kaggle_profile_wrapper_attempt2.py) and reused the canonical trainer through the existing bundle runner.
+
+## Outcome
+
+Attempt 1 requested `NvidiaTeslaP100`, but Kaggle allocated two Tesla T4 GPUs. The worker was pinned to device 0 and had a 297-second effective deadline. It timed out after 270.556 worker seconds with zero GPU allocation and no worker log. Its raw input hashes were deferred and never observed. The provider quota delta was 305.803 seconds; the conservative dual-device bound is 611.606 seconds, which exceeds the then 600-second bound by 11.606 seconds. The complete collection is in [archived terminal_collection](archives/README.md).
+
+Attempt 2 explicitly requested `NvidiaTeslaT4` and again received two T4s. One worker used device 0. Its 898-second effective deadline was under the 1200-second outer cap with a 300-second finalizer reserve. The wrapper verified the original and derived manifest hashes and confirmed their membership and evaluation fields were equal. It entered canonical `wnn.splits.load_campaign_split`; that call completed portable SHA checks for both raw parquets, then failed because `cache/chains.npz` was absent. Worker wall time was 482.874 seconds, peak GPU allocation was zero, and no training import or profile update occurred. The exact terminal output and worker files are preserved in [archived terminal_collection_attempt2](archives/README.md), with provider polling in [provider_polls_attempt2.jsonl](provider_polls_attempt2.jsonl).
+
+The actual provider quota decrement in attempt 2 was 492.972 seconds, while the conservative two-device budget bound is 985.944 seconds. Across both attempts the measured quota decrement was 798.775 seconds. The post-attempt-2 account snapshot showed 90,722.348 of 108,000 GPU seconds used, zero reserved, 17,277.652 unreserved, and refresh at 2026-10-24 00:00 UTC. The provider response exposes aggregate seconds and no device multiplier; the attempt-specific charge is recorded without assuming future dual-T4 billing. The exact owner+slug status poll returned `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR`; Kaggle did not expose a session ID.
+
+The installed SDK accepts T4 and P100 shape identifiers, but the P100 request was actually allocated dual T4s. A current single-GPU shape was not verified. The SDK has no account-wide live-session listing endpoint, and zero reserved seconds does not prove all unrelated kernels are terminal. No current-cycle reservation record was found. The earlier read-only asset, quota, and SDK-interface inventory is [KAGGLE_DELIVERY_READINESS_20261021_R1.json](../kaggle_delivery_readiness_r1/KAGGLE_DELIVERY_READINESS_20261021_R1.json).
+
+## Required repair before another profile
+
+The profile-only manifest correctly contains exactly the canonical raw `train.parquet` and `valid.parquet` sources, preserving all non-source membership and evaluation fields bit for bit. The canonical split loader also needs two small structural graph caches that are not source-membership entries: `cache/chains.npz` (650,142 bytes, SHA-256 `39aba46f…`) and `cache/chain_folds.npz` (550,072 bytes, SHA-256 `a2cfe843…`). Stage those exact files at the expected root paths and verify their hashes before calling the canonical loader. Keep the profile manifest sources unchanged. A future worker deadline must include the observed roughly 483-second raw-source preflight, profile setup and updates, serialization, and finalizer reserve.
+
+The second diagnostic attempt exhausted the authorized profile retry. A future profile needs a new controller decision after review of this diagnosis; any fit also remains uncosted and unadmitted until a genuine finite profile and its quota delta are recorded.
+
+## Provenance and limits
+
+The packet uses the existing `scripts/kaggle_bundle.py`, `scripts/kaggle_gpu_runner.py`, `scripts/kaggle_common.py`, `scripts/kaggle_kernel.py`, and unchanged canonical `scripts/train_rnn.py`/`src/wnn` code. No copied trainer, target cache, initializer, propensity asset, credential, or scientific fit was included. The requested training source revision was `68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440`; the bundled checkout was `d3055423a185d2ecfe7baf1c20206abeb743ad8b`, with no diff in the listed training and Kaggle runner paths. This receipt is engineering and provider-delivery evidence only, not evidence about quality or expected public score.
+
+## Lossless source/terminal archive
+
+The original input bundles, terminal trees and derived split manifest are preserved in [the verified snapshot archive](archives/README.md). Historical paths in the immutable terminal receipt are archive member paths relative to this packet. Every file digest was checked after packing; no raw bytes or results were edited. The small [attempt2 diagnostic wrapper](kaggle_profile_wrapper_attempt2.py) is available directly for source review.
